key:
Total radiation dose the electronics have taken, in grays of silicon. The core fails for good at its tolerance.

Converted from the sieverts a kitten would take here: the weighting for harm to living tissue is taken out (protons count half, cosmic rays 0.4, electrons in full), then scaled by 0.8 because silicon absorbs a little less energy than tissue.
english:
Total radiation dose the electronics have taken, in grays of silicon. The core fails for good at its tolerance.

Converted from the sieverts a kitten would take here: the weighting for harm to living tissue is taken out (protons count half, cosmic rays 0.4, electrons in full), then scaled by 0.8 because silicon absorbs a little less energy than tissue.
chinese:
电子设备累积吸收的辐射剂量，以硅的吸收剂量（Gy）表示。达到耐受剂量后，核心将永久失效。

换算以喵航员在此处受到的当量剂量（Sv）为基础，先去除生物损伤权重（质子乘以一半，宇宙射线乘以 0.4，电子按全量计），再乘以 0.8，以反映硅吸收的能量略低于生物组织。

key: CrewClockTooltip
english: The next thing that happens to a kitten if nothing changes: its supply running low, then being impaired, incapacitated or dying without it, or radiation sickness or death from its radiation dose. Within a day the worst comes first, otherwise the soonest. Click to take control of that vessel, or to open Life Support when it is the vessel you control. Show or hide the clock from the View menu ({Key}).
chinese: 若现状持续，显示喵航员接下来会遇到的情况：物资告急，物资耗尽后行动受限、丧失行动能力或死亡，或因累积辐射剂量患病或死亡。一天内的事件优先显示最严重的，其余优先显示最早的。单击可切换至相应载具；若已在操控该载具，则打开生命保障窗口。在“视图”菜单中可显示或隐藏乘员倒计时（{Key}）。

key: LifeSupportTooltipBackLeg

chinese: 返程航段：从离开目的地直到返回出发地。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewMoves
english: Kittens change zones between legs. A move through a hatch needs it open, a move by EVA is a spacewalk.
chinese: 喵航员可在航段之间更换居住区。经舱口通行需要打开舱门，也可通过舱外活动转移。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewPlan
english: How many kittens ride in each zone on each leg. Food and CO₂ canisters stay in their zone, so plan where each kitten rides.
chinese: 规划每个航段各居住区的乘员数。餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐留在各自居住区，请据此安排乘员。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCustomLeg

key: LifeSupportTooltipFewerKittens

chinese: 此航段在该居住区少安排一名喵航员。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipKittenDays
english: Days × kittens, added up over the legs. A kitten eats {Meals} meals a day, and a CO₂ canister lasts {KittenDays} kitten-days.
chinese: 将各航段的天数乘以对应的乘员数，再相加得到乘员人天数。每名喵航员每天吃 {Meals} 份餐食，每个 CO₂ 吸收罐可供使用 {KittenDays} 人天。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipMoreKittens
english: One more kitten in this zone on this leg.
chinese: 此航段在该居住区多安排一名喵航员。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipNoKittensToSpare
english: Every kitten aboard is already planned on this leg. Assign more kittens to seats to plan more.
chinese: 此航段已安排全部在船乘员。若要增加计划人数，请先为更多喵航员分配座位。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipOutLeg
english: Out Leg: from launch until arriving at the destination.
chinese: 去程航段：从发射直到抵达目的地。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipOverfull
english: More kittens are planned on this leg than are seated aboard. Assign more kittens, or plan fewer.
chinese: 此航段的计划人数超过实际就座人数。请增加就座乘员，或减少计划人数。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipSeatsFull

chinese: 计划已占用该居住区的全部座位。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipStayLeg

chinese: 停留航段：在目的地度过的时间，包括等待返程转移窗口的时间。

key: SettingsSimulationStockMarginTooltip

chinese: 按任务备货时，在任务所需餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐的基础上额外装载的比例。转移耗时是估算值，留出余量可应对延误。

key: LifeSupportTooltipPickOpenHatch
english: Open the hatch first: it is listed under To in the Transfer Supplies window.
chinese: 请先打开舱门。可在“转移物资”窗口的“转入”一栏找到该舱门。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipStockZone
english: Sets this zone's meals and CO₂ canisters to cover its crew plan plus a {Margin}% margin, as far as its storage allows. Lockers it doesn't need are emptied. The margin is in Settings, Simulation.
chinese: 按该区的乘员计划装载餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐，并预留 {Margin}% 的余量，最多装至储存空间上限。多余物资柜会清空。余量可在“设置”的“模拟”中调整。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipStorageShort
english: {Meals} meals and {Canisters} CO₂ canisters won't fit in this zone's storage. Add a habitat or cargo bay to the zone, or plan fewer kitten-days in it.
chinese: 该区还有 {Meals} 份餐食和 {Canisters} 个 CO₂ 吸收罐放不下。请增加居住舱或货舱，或减少该区计划的乘员人天数。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCloseHatch
english: Close the hatch. Each side becomes its own zone and keeps the supplies stored on its side.
chinese: 关闭舱门。两侧将分成独立的居住区，各自保留本侧储存的物资。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipClosedHatch
english: A closed docking hatch separates this zone from the other.
chinese: 一道关闭的对接舱门将两个居住区隔开。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipConnected
english: Other zones on this vessel. An open hatch joins two zones so their crew and supplies can move between them.
chinese: 此载具上的其他居住区。打开舱门可合并两区，让乘员和物资通行。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewSeats
english: The kitten in each seat in this zone, the same as the part window's Crew combos. With nobody assigned the window plans for every seat.
chinese: 显示该区各座位的喵航员，与部件窗口中的乘员选择一致。如果没有分配乘员，规划时按全部座位计算。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrew
english: Kittens seated in this zone, their seat and their condition.
chinese: 显示该居住区的喵航员、所在座位和身体状况。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewAssigned
english: Kittens assigned to seats in this zone.
chinese: 分配至该居住区座位的喵航员。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewEverySeat
english: Nobody is assigned a seat so every seat is counted. Assign kittens, or pick a mission and plan the crew, to count fewer.
chinese: 尚未分配乘员，因此按全部座位计算。可分配乘员，或选择任务并规划各航段的实际人数。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewFlight
english: Kittens in this zone and how long until its first supply runs out.
chinese: 显示该区的喵航员，以及距离第一种物资耗尽还有多久。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewIncapacitated
english: Every kitten in this zone is incapacitated
chinese: 该居住区的所有喵航员均已丧失行动能力
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCrewPlanned
english: Kittens from the crew plan above. A range means the count changes between legs.
chinese: 人数来自上方的乘员计划。显示范围表示各航段的人数不同。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipEvaCarry
english: EVA to carry: press {Key} near it
chinese: 通过舱外活动搬运：靠近后按 {Key}
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipEvaOnly
english: No docked hatch leads there. Kittens and supplies get there by EVA.
chinese: 没有对接舱门通往此处。乘员和物资须通过舱外活动转移。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipHabitats
english: Parts in this zone that store meals and CO₂ canisters. The crew can only eat and scrub from stores in their own zone.
chinese: 该区内储存餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐的部件。乘员只能使用本区储存的餐食和吸收罐。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTimingAsPlanned
english: Times each leg as planned in the editor, counted from launch.
chinese: 按编辑器中的计划计算各航段时间，从发射时开始计时。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTimingFlightPlan
english: Times the arrival from when your flight plan reaches the mission's destination, then adds the planned stay and trip home. Once the vessel arrives or leaves, the real times are used.
chinese: 以飞行计划抵达任务目的地的时间为基准，再加上计划停留和返程时间。载具实际抵达或离开后，改用实际时间。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTimingNoDestination
english: This mission has no destination body, so it can only be timed as planned.
chinese: 该任务未指定目的天体，只能按原计划计时。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTimingNoEncounter
english: Your flight plan doesn't reach the mission's destination. Plan a transfer there to time the mission from it.
chinese: 飞行计划尚未抵达任务目的地。规划一条通往目的地的转移轨道后，即可据此计时。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTimingLeft
english: Time until the mission's last leg ends. The dashed line on each zone's bars marks where that zone's last leg ends.
chinese: 距离任务最后一个航段结束的时间。各区条形图上的虚线标记该区最后一个航段的结束时间。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipMissionEnough
english: Every zone's supplies last until its last crewed leg ends.
chinese: 每个居住区的物资都能维持到该区最后一个载人航段结束。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipMissionShort
english: The zone that runs shortest, its first supply to run out, and how long before the zone's last leg ends.
chinese: 显示物资缺口最大的居住区、该区最先耗尽的物资，以及物资会比该区最后一个航段结束早多久耗尽。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipNoCrewToCarry
english: No kitten in this zone to move supplies
chinese: 该区没有可搬运物资的喵航员
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipNothingToMove
english: Nothing stored here to move
chinese: 此处没有可转移的物资
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipOpenHatch
english: Opening the hatch will join the two zones so kittens and supplies can move between them.
chinese: 打开舱门将两个居住区连为一体，使乘员和物资可以通行。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipOpenHatchRow
english: This open docking hatch joins the two sides into one zone.
chinese: 这道对接舱门已打开，两侧属于同一居住区。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipShortfall
english: Air and water come from the vessel's tanks, but meals and CO₂ canisters must be stored in the crew's own zone.
chinese: 空气和水来自载具上的储罐，但餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐必须存放在乘员所在的居住区。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipStores
english: {Meals} meals feed one kitten for {Days}. {Canisters} CO₂ canisters scrub for {KittenDays} kitten-days.
chinese: {Meals} 份餐食可供一名喵航员食用 {Days}。{Canisters} 个 CO₂ 吸收罐可供使用 {KittenDays} 人天。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTransfer
english: Move meals and CO₂ canisters to another habitat in this zone. A kitten in the zone carries them.
chinese: 将餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐转移到同一居住区的另一个舱段，由该区的一名喵航员搬运。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipVolumes
english: Habitable is the pressurised space the crew lives in, and how much each kitten gets. Storage is the space for meals and CO₂ canisters.
chinese: 宜居容积是乘员生活的加压空间，同时显示人均容积。储存容积用于存放餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipWorst
english: The supply that runs out first on this vessel, and the zone it runs out in with the current crew.
chinese: 按当前乘员分布，显示载具上最先耗尽的物资及其所在居住区。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipZone
english: A zone is the habitat parts kittens can reach without EVA. Meals and CO₂ canisters stay in their zone. Air and water are shared across the vessel.
chinese: 居住区由无需舱外活动即可往来的宜居舱段组成。餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐留在各自区内，空气和水由整艘载具共享。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipStockAll
english: Stocks every crewed zone's meals and CO₂ canisters for its crew plan plus a {Margin}% margin, as far as each zone's storage allows, and fills the air and water tanks the same way. The margin is in Settings, Simulation.
chinese: 按各载人居住区的乘员计划装载餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐，并预留 {Margin}% 的余量，最多装至各区储存空间上限。空气和水储罐也按此原则补充。余量可在“设置”的“模拟”中调整。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipFillTanks
english: Fills the vessel's air and water tanks to cover the crew plan plus a {Margin}% margin, or to full when that isn't enough. Tanks are never emptied.
chinese: 按乘员计划补充空气和水，并预留 {Margin}% 的余量；若容量不足则加至满罐。现有储量只增不减。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTankSupply
english: Air and water come from tanks the whole vessel shares. What the tanks hold now, what they hold when full, and what the mission plus the margin needs. Only tanks with Air or Water in their Role Affinity count.
chinese: 整艘载具共享空气和水储罐。这里列出当前储量、满罐容量和含余量的任务需求。仅计入用途设为空气或水的储罐。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipTankMissing
english: Even full, the vessel's tanks can't cover the mission plus the margin. Add a tank and set its Role Affinity to this supply in the part window.
chinese: 即使装满，现有储罐也无法满足含余量的任务需求。请添加储罐，并在部件窗口将其用途设为所缺物资。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCustom
english: Type the mission's length yourself for trips the picker can't describe.
chinese: 当目的地选择器无法描述行程时，可自行输入任务时长。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCustomLength
english: The whole mission's length from launch to the end.
chinese: 从发射至任务结束的总时长。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipHohmann
english: Out and Back are the lowest-fuel transfers between circular orbits. A faster transfer shortens the trip but costs more fuel.
chinese: 去程和返程采用圆轨道间最省燃料的转移方式。更快的转移能缩短航程，但会消耗更多燃料。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipCruise
english: How fast the trip between the stars goes, as a fraction of the speed of light.
chinese: 以光速的比例表示恒星之间的巡航速度。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipInterstellarLegs
english: Out and Back cross the gap between the stars at the cruise speed. Speeding up and slowing down aren't counted, so a real trip takes a little longer. Reaching a planet then adds a transfer from its star.
chinese: 去程和返程按巡航速度跨越恒星间距。估算未计入加速和减速，实际航程会稍长。若目的地是行星，还会加上从其恒星到行星的转移时间。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipMission
english: Plan a trip. The plan is saved with the vehicle.
chinese: 规划行程。计划会随载具一同保存。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipPlan
english: Flyby passes the body without stopping. Orbit and Land stay for the Stay time. One way plans no trip home.
chinese: 飞掠只经过天体。环绕和着陆会按设定的时间停留。单程任务不安排返程。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipStay
english: Days at the destination. A return trip may stay longer while it waits for the next transfer window home.
chinese: 在目的地停留的天数。往返任务可能需要延长停留，以等待下一个返程转移窗口。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: EditorHistoryStockForMission
english: Stock for mission
chinese: 按任务备货
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: EditorHistoryFillTanks
english: Fill air and water
chinese: 补充空气和水
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: TransferPlannerMissionEnough
english: With this transfer, every zone's supplies last the rest of the mission. The trip, the stay and the trip home.
chinese: 采用此转移时，各区物资均可维持至任务结束，包括去程、停留和返程。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: TransferPlannerMissionShort
english: With this transfer, the zone that runs shortest runs out of this supply before its last mission leg ends.
chinese: 采用此转移时，物资缺口最大的居住区将在其最后一个任务航段结束前耗尽这项物资。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: TransferPlannerMissionLate
english: This transfer arrives later than the mission planned. The supplies line above counts from this arrival.
chinese: 此转移的抵达时间晚于任务计划。上方物资估算已按此次抵达时间计算。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: TransferPlannerMissionElsewhere
english: This transfer goes somewhere other than the vessel's mission destination.
chinese: 此转移前往的地点与载具的任务目的地不同。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: TransferPlannerUpdateMission
english: Make this transfer's destination the mission's. The plan, stay and trip home stay the same.
chinese: 将此次转移的目的地设为任务目的地，保留原有任务方式、停留时间和返程安排。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipSeatIncapacitated

notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipSeatMove

notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipSeatNoEmpty
english: No empty seat in this zone
chinese: 该居住区没有空座位
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipAir
english: Air comes from the vessel's air tanks shared by every kitten aboard. Each kitten breathes {Mass} kg a day.
chinese: 空气来自全体乘员共享的空气储罐。每名喵航员每天呼吸消耗 {Mass} kg 空气。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipFood

chinese: 食物来自本区舱段内储存的餐食。每名喵航员每天吃 {Meals} 份。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipScrubber

chinese: CO₂ 吸收罐储存在本区舱段内，每罐可供使用 {KittenDays} 人天。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LifeSupportTooltipWater

chinese: 水来自全体乘员共享的水储罐。每名喵航员每天饮用 {Mass} kg 水。

notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: FlightComputerTooltipProbeCoreStormStandby

notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: FlightComputerTooltipProbeCoreRebooting

chinese: 探测器核心受辐射扰动影响，正在重启。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: FlightComputerTooltipNoCrew

notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: FlightComputerTooltipProbeCoreUnpowered

chinese: 探测器核心供电不足。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: FlightComputerTooltipProbeCoreOff

chinese: 探测器核心的电源已关闭。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LaunchMenuTooltipMission
english: The mission saved with this craft. Change it in the vehicle editor's Life Support window.

notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LaunchMenuTooltipShortStores
english: The zone that runs shortest and its first supply to run out. Stock All fills meals and CO₂ canisters for this launch. If the zone's storage is full, add storage in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 显示物资缺口最大的居住区及最先耗尽的物资。“全部备货”可为本次发射补充餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐。若储存空间已满，请在编辑器中增设储存部件。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LaunchMenuTooltipShortTanks

chinese: 空气和水由载具储罐提供。“全部备货”最多补充至满罐；若要增加容量，请在载具编辑器中修改。

key: LaunchMenuTooltipStockAll
english: Set every crewed zone's meals and CO₂ canisters to cover its crew plan plus the {Margin}% margin from Settings, as far as storage allows, and fill the air and water tanks the same way. Only this launch changes, not the saved craft.
chinese: 按各载人居住区的乘员计划装载餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐，并加上设置中的 {Margin}% 余量，最多装至储存空间上限。空气和水储罐也按此原则补充。这仅影响本次发射，已保存的载具设计保持原样。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LaunchMenuTooltipNoMission
english: Pick a mission in the vehicle editor's Life Support window and save the craft, and its supplies are checked against the mission before launch.
chinese: 在载具编辑器的“生命保障”窗口选择任务并保存载具，即可在发射前按任务检查物资。
notes: 5901 display text. Keep source identity, units and format arguments.

key: LaunchMenuTooltipOpenInEditor

chinese: 在载具编辑器中打开已保存的载具，修改其储罐、储存空间、任务或乘员计划。在此菜单中选择的乘员和装载量不会带入编辑器。

key: Changed Reimported a number of art assets to fix collider authoring. These include: Tanks, Rcs, engines, Docking, Nosecones.
english: Changed Reimported a number of art assets to fix collider authoring. These include: Tanks, Rcs, engines, Docking, Nosecones.
chinese: 重新导入了储罐、RCS、发动机、对接部件和鼻锥等美术资源，修正碰撞体。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed connector sizing of cargo bay parts to 0.25m.
english: Changed connector sizing of cargo bay parts to 0.25m.
chinese: 将货舱部件的连接尺寸改为 0.25m。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed an edge case for incorrect variant grouping in GLB import tool.
english: Fixed an edge case for incorrect variant grouping in GLB import tool.
chinese: 修复了 GLB 导入工具中变体分组错误的边缘情况。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed EVA suits to always fill with oxygen and a CO₂ cartridge. In breathable air the suit doesn't use them so a kitten that leaves near the ground and then finds themselves somewhere where the atmosphere is no longer left with a death sentence.
english: Changed EVA suits to always fill with oxygen and a CO₂ cartridge. In breathable air the suit doesn't use them so a kitten that leaves near the ground and then finds themselves somewhere where the atmosphere is no longer left with a death sentence.
chinese: 舱外航天服现在总会补充氧气和 CO₂ 吸收罐。在可呼吸环境中航天服不消耗储备，因此从近地面出舱后进入不可呼吸环境的喵航员仍有维生物资可用。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The EVA suit tooltip on the crew portrait shows the oxygen and cartridge time held in reserve while breathing outside air.
english: The EVA suit tooltip on the crew portrait shows the oxygen and cartridge time held in reserve while breathing outside air.
chinese: 乘员肖像上的航天服提示现在会显示呼吸外界空气时，备用氧气和吸收罐各能维持多久。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed EVA kittens staying controllable after becoming incapacitated. An incapacitated kitten can't walk, use its jetpack, grab, let go of a ladder or carry supplies, and any held keys are released.
english: Fixed EVA kittens staying controllable after becoming incapacitated. An incapacitated kitten can't walk, use its jetpack, grab, let go of a ladder or carry supplies, and any held keys are released.
chinese: 修复舱外喵航员丧失行动能力后仍可操控的问题。此时无法行走、使用喷气背包、抓握、松开梯子或搬运物资，所有已按下的按键也会释放。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: It can still board with B when it is in range of a hatch, whether or not it is on a ladder.
english: It can still board with B when it is in range of a hatch, whether or not it is on a ladder.
chinese: 只要在舱门范围内，仍可按 B 登舱，无论是否抓着梯子。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the EVA suit filling in breathable air.
english: Added unit tests for the EVA suit filling in breathable air.
chinese: 为 EVA 宇航服在可呼吸空气中填充功能添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed a crash when decoupling a vessel holding habitats or supply lockers such as a capsule from a service bay with supply lockers.
english: Fixed a crash when decoupling a vessel holding habitats or supply lockers such as a capsule from a service bay with supply lockers.
chinese: 修复了从带有居住区或补给柜（如飞船舱）的服务舱分离时导致崩溃的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a unit test for habitat zones after a split.
english: Added a unit test for habitat zones after a split.
chinese: 为居住区分裂后添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed a crash when a vessel's orbit has an eccentricity just below 1 such as during a slow capture burn or when using Set Orbit with an eccentricity of 0.9999995.
english: Fixed a crash when a vessel's orbit has an eccentricity just below 1 such as during a slow capture burn or when using Set Orbit with an eccentricity of 0.9999995.
chinese: 修复了当飞船轨道偏心率略低于 1（例如在缓慢捕获点火期间或使用偏心率为 0.9999995 的设定轨道时）导致的崩溃。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a unit test for orbits just below an eccentricity of 1.
english: Added a unit test for orbits just below an eccentricity of 1.
chinese: 为偏心率略低于 1 的轨道添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed a vessel's flight computer raising its attitude deadband after a decoupler split docking or undocking, which made attitude hold sloppy until the profile was reselected. The deadband now comes from the vessel's own thrusters.
english: Fixed a vessel's flight computer raising its attitude deadband after a decoupler split docking or undocking, which made attitude hold sloppy until the profile was reselected. The deadband now comes from the vessel's own thrusters.
chinese: 修复分离器分离、对接或解除对接后飞行计算机增大姿态控制死区的问题。之前需要重新选择配置才能恢复姿态保持精度；现在根据载具自身的推进器计算死区。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a unit test for the thruster cache after a split.
english: Added a unit test for the thruster cache after a split.
chinese: 为分裂后的推进器缓存添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed menu highlighting being offset from the mouse in windowed mode on some Linux desktops. Long menus now stay inside the game window and scroll.
english: Fixed menu highlighting being offset from the mouse in windowed mode on some Linux desktops. Long menus now stay inside the game window and scroll.
chinese: 修复了某些 Linux 桌面窗口模式下菜单高亮与鼠标位置偏移的问题。长菜单现在保留在游戏窗口内并滚动。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed an intermittent unit test failure in the editor snapshot allocation tests.
english: Fixed an intermittent unit test failure in the editor snapshot allocation tests.
chinese: 修复了编辑器快照分配测试中的间歇性单元测试失败。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed Animation jank in the jump anim that was especially visible in lower gravities. This was due to the jump start and end anims being incorectly played as looping animations, the controller now transitions between states cleanly.
english: Fixed Animation jank in the jump anim that was especially visible in lower gravities. This was due to the jump start and end anims being incorectly played as looping animations, the controller now transitions between states cleanly.
chinese: 修复了跳跃动画在低重力下特别明显的跳跃动画卡顿问题。这是由于跳跃开始和结束动画被错误地作为循环动画播放，控制器现在干净地在状态之间切换。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed All nose cone variants now have room for fuel.
english: Changed All nose cone variants now have room for fuel.
chinese: 所有鼻锥变体现在都有燃料空间。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removed Decouplers from fuel tank interstage parts and fixed the end caps not showing on them.
english: Removed Decouplers from fuel tank interstage parts and fixed the end caps not showing on them.
chinese: 从燃料箱中间段部件中移除了解耦器，并修复了端盖未显示的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added the Resources gauge to the vehicle editor. LEt's you see resources in the vehicle but specifically when the vessel has crew it gives you how many days the vehicle's air, water, food and CO₂ scrubber supplies last.
english: Added the Resources gauge to the vehicle editor. LEt's you see resources in the vehicle but specifically when the vessel has crew it gives you how many days the vehicle's air, water, food and CO₂ scrubber supplies last.
chinese: 在载具编辑器中添加了资源仪表。让我们看看载具中的资源；特别是当载具有船员时，它会显示载具的空气、水、食物和 CO₂吸收罐供应还能维持多少天。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: This is in addition to the warnings at the bottom of the dV readout UI.
english: This is in addition to the warnings at the bottom of the dV readout UI.
chinese: 这除了底部 dV 读数 UI 中的警告之外。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added power use to probe cores with an on/off switch in their part window. A probe core only controls the vessel while it is switched on and has power, and its part window shows how long its power will last.
english: Added power use to probe cores with an on/off switch in their part window. A probe core only controls the vessel while it is switched on and has power, and its part window shows how long its power will last.
chinese: 探测器核心现在会耗电，部件窗口中新增了电源开关，并显示剩余供电时间。只有已开启且有电的核心才能操控载具。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Time warp stops with a warning once, 5 minutes before an uncrewed vessel's probe cores run out of power and again when it loses control.
english: Time warp stops with a warning once, 5 minutes before an uncrewed vessel's probe cores run out of power and again when it loses control.
chinese: 无人载具的探测器核心将在电力耗尽前 5 分钟发出警告并停止时间加速；失去控制时会再次停止时间加速。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for probe core power.
english: Added unit tests for probe core power.
chinese: 为探测核心电源添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a status light to probe cores: green when powered, yellow when under 5 minutes of power remains, red when out of power, and dark when switched off.
english: Added a status light to probe cores: green when powered, yellow when under 5 minutes of power remains, red when out of power, and dark when switched off.
chinese: 为探测核心添加了状态指示灯：通电时为绿色，剩余电量少于 5 分钟时为黄色，无电时为红色，关闭时为暗色。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added an Auto mode to the probe core power switch, now the default. An Auto probe core stands by without using power while a crewed pod or another probe core flies the vessel, takes over when nothing else can, and shows a blue light on standby.
english: Added an Auto mode to the probe core power switch, now the default. An Auto probe core stands by without using power while a crewed pod or another probe core flies the vessel, takes over when nothing else can, and shows a blue light on standby.
chinese: 探测器核心的电源开关新增默认的自动模式。当载人指令舱或其他核心操控载具时，本核心会进入零功耗待机并亮蓝灯；若无其他部件可操控，则自动接管。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Convert all remaining legacy render pass/framebuffer usage to dynamic rendering.
english: Convert all remaining legacy render pass/framebuffer usage to dynamic rendering.
chinese: 将所有剩余的旧版渲染通道/帧缓冲使用转换为动态渲染。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Avoid depth clear when redundant.
english: Avoid depth clear when redundant.
chinese: 避免不必要的深度清除。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Parameterize additional shader color formats.
english: Parameterize additional shader color formats.
chinese: 参数化了额外的着色器颜色格式。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed a crash when opening a probe core's part window.
english: Fixed a crash when opening a probe core's part window.
chinese: 修复了打开探测核心部件窗口时的崩溃问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a unit test for the probe core power switch options.
english: Added a unit test for the probe core power switch options.
chinese: 为探测核心电源开关选项添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added radiation wear to probe cores as a new Avionics part module. Their electronics collect radiation dose which is shown in the part window.
english: Added radiation wear to probe cores as a new Avionics part module. Their electronics collect radiation dose which is shown in the part window.
chinese: 为探测器核心新增航电模块，模拟电子设备的辐射损伤，并在部件窗口显示其累积剂量。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Dose is counted in grays of silicon converted from the sieverts a kitten would take.
english: Dose is counted in grays of silicon converted from the sieverts a kitten would take.
chinese: 将喵航员在当地承受的当量剂量（Sv）换算为硅吸收的剂量（Gy）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The weighting that makes sieverts measure harm to living tissue is taken back out (trapped and solar protons count half, cosmic rays 0.4, trapped electrons in full)
english: The weighting that makes sieverts measure harm to living tissue is taken back out (trapped and solar protons count half, cosmic rays 0.4, trapped electrons in full)
chinese: 换算时先去除体现生物组织损伤的权重：俘获质子和太阳质子按一半计算，宇宙射线乘以 0.4，俘获电子按全量计算。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: then scaled by 0.8 because silicon absorbs a little less energy than tissue.
english: then scaled by 0.8 because silicon absorbs a little less energy than tissue.
chinese: 再乘以 0.8，因为硅吸收的能量略低于组织。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: They will fail for good at their tolerance limit (also shown in the part window). When switched off or on standby they collect half as much.
english: They will fail for good at their tolerance limit (also shown in the part window). When switched off or on standby they collect half as much.
chinese: 达到耐受剂量后核心将永久失效；部件窗口也会显示耐受值。关机或待机时吸收剂量减半。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Eventually I invisage spare parts and EVA engineer kittens will be able to repair failed electronics. But until then, they die, they die.
english: Eventually I invisage spare parts and EVA engineer kittens will be able to repair failed electronics. But until then, they die, they die.
chinese: 未来希望让工程师喵航员在舱外使用备件维修失效的电子设备。眼下，坏了就是坏了。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: You can turn off radiation rules if you really need to in the meantime and they will come back to life.
english: You can turn off radiation rules if you really need to in the meantime and they will come back to life.
chinese: 如有需要，可暂时关闭辐射规则，核心便能恢复工作。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for probe core radiation.
english: Added unit tests for probe core radiation.
chinese: 为探测器核心辐射添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added radiation upsets to probe cores. A running core reboots at random more often in radiation belts and solar storms and gives no control for 30 seconds while it does. A backup core on Auto can take over while one is rebooting.
english: Added radiation upsets to probe cores. A running core reboots at random more often in radiation belts and solar storms and gives no control for 30 seconds while it does. A backup core on Auto can take over while one is rebooting.
chinese: 探测器核心现在可能因辐射扰动而重启。在辐射带和太阳风暴中，工作中的核心更易随机重启，期间 30 秒无法操控载具。处于自动模式的备用核心可接管。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Standby In Storms setting to probe cores. The core stands by, safe from upsets and taking half the dose while a radiation storm is under way at the vessel's location, and goes back on when it passes.
english: Added a Standby In Storms setting to probe cores. The core stands by, safe from upsets and taking half the dose while a radiation storm is under way at the vessel's location, and goes back on when it passes.
chinese: 探测器核心新增“辐射风暴期间待机”。风暴影响载具时，核心待机以避免辐射扰动，吸收剂量减半，风暴过去后恢复。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for probe core upsets and storm standby.
english: Added unit tests for probe core upsets and storm standby.
chinese: 为探测器核心干扰和风暴待机添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added the probe core power switch and Standby In Storms setting to the vehicle editor's part settings, so a core can be set before launch.
english: Added the probe core power switch and Standby In Storms setting to the vehicle editor's part settings, so a core can be set before launch.
chinese: 将探测器核心电源开关和“风暴中待机”设置添加到载具编辑器的部件设置中，以便在发射前设置核心。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reimported Fairing instage assets for updated collision geometry.
english: Reimported Fairing instage assets for updated collision geometry.
chinese: 重新导入整流罩一级资产以更新碰撞几何形状。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added InterstageBridgeHollow1WHalfWA.
english: Added InterstageBridgeHollow1WHalfWA.
chinese: 添加了 InterstageBridgeHollow1WHalfWA。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed the IVA cabin light ignoring the capsule's light switch. The cabin light should now react when the switch is toggled or when the power is depleted instead of always being active.
english: Fixed the IVA cabin light ignoring the capsule's light switch. The cabin light should now react when the switch is toggled or when the power is depleted instead of always being active.
chinese: 修复了 IVA 舱灯忽略飞船开关的问题。现在舱灯应在切换开关或耗尽电源时反应，而不是始终处于激活状态。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a collapse button to the Resources panel in flight and in the vehicle editor that rolls it up to just its header.
english: Added a collapse button to the Resources panel in flight and in the vehicle editor that rolls it up to just its header.
chinese: 在飞行中和载具编辑器中为资源面板添加了折叠按钮，将其折叠至仅保留标题栏。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed vessels that lose control (crew incapacitated or gone, or a probe core out of power, failed, rebooting, on storm standby or switched off) to drop attitude hold and cancel any auto burn. A manual throttle is held where it was.
english: Changed vessels that lose control (crew incapacitated or gone, or a probe core out of power, failed, rebooting, on storm standby or switched off) to drop attitude hold and cancel any auto burn. A manual throttle is held where it was.
chinese: 将失去控制（船员丧失能力或死亡，或探测器核心断电、故障、重启、风暴待机或关闭）的飞船改为释放姿态保持并取消任何自动燃烧。手动油门保持在之前的位置。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Updated CoreStructuralB Texture atlas.
english: Updated CoreStructuralB Texture atlas.
chinese: 更新了 CoreStructuralB 纹理图集。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed the part highlight (habitat zones, fuel flow and others) to tint parts and glow at their edges instead of painting over them. So part details stay visible while highlighted.
english: Changed the part highlight (habitat zones, fuel flow and others) to tint parts and glow at their edges instead of painting over them. So part details stay visible while highlighted.
chinese: 更改了部件高亮（居住区、燃料流动等）的方式，使其对部件进行着色并在边缘发光，而不是覆盖它们。这样在突出显示时仍能看清部件细节。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Tidied life support wording. one name per supply (Air, Water, Food, CO₂ Scrubber), times in the same one short format. no internal id names on habitat, seat and boarding labels. Food and scrubber descriptions that match the game. With the Life Support rule off, its banner, gauges and supply panels are now hidden.
english: Tidied life support wording. one name per supply (Air, Water, Food, CO₂ Scrubber), times in the same one short format. no internal id names on habitat, seat and boarding labels. Food and scrubber descriptions that match the game. With the Life Support rule off, its banner, gauges and supply panels are now hidden.
chinese: 整理了生命保障措辞。每种供应品一个名称（空气、水、食物、CO₂吸收罐），时间使用相同的简短格式。居住区、座位和登机标签不再包含内部 ID 名称。食物和吸收罐的描述与游戏中一致。当生命保障规则关闭时，其横幅、仪表和资源面板现在会被隐藏。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Made the life support summaries lead to the details. Clicking the "Life support low" banner, the Resources panel's LIFE SUPPORT block or the new Life Support button in a habitat's part window opens the Habitat Zones window for that vessel.
english: Made the life support summaries lead to the details. Clicking the "Life support low" banner, the Resources panel's LIFE SUPPORT block or the new Life Support button in a habitat's part window opens the Habitat Zones window for that vessel.
chinese: 使生命保障摘要指向详细信息。点击“生命保障低”横幅、资源面板中的 LIFE SUPPORT 块或栖息区部件窗口中的新生命保障按钮，将打开该飞船的栖息区窗口。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed the life support banner to name the vessel, the supply running short and how long it lasts. e.g. "Life support low: Lander 2 · Air 23 h".
english: Changed the life support banner to name the vessel, the supply running short and how long it lasts. e.g. "Life support low: Lander 2 · Air 23 h".
chinese: 更改了生命保障横幅，显示飞船名称、供应品短缺量以及剩余时间。例如："生命保障低：着陆器 2 · 空气 23 小时"。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: It says "Life support out" once a supply is gone, names the kitten's suit on EVA and adds the zone when more than one zone has crew.
english: It says "Life support out" once a supply is gone, names the kitten's suit on EVA and adds the zone when more than one zone has crew.
chinese: 当某种供应品耗尽时，它会显示“生命保障结束”，并在 EVA 中显示喵航员的宇航服名称，并且在多个区域有船员时显示所在区域。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed the Resources panel's LIFE SUPPORT header to name the zone its times come from when more than one zone has crew. On EVA its warning colours now use the suit's warning times.
english: Changed the Resources panel's LIFE SUPPORT header to name the zone its times come from when more than one zone has crew. On EVA its warning colours now use the suit's warning times.
chinese: 将资源面板的生命保障标题修改为显示该区域所属的航段（当多个区域有船员时）。在 EVA 模式下，警告颜色现在使用宇航服的剩余时间。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Cut the part window's life support block to one line, e.g. "Zone 1 · Lasts 3.0 d · Air", in its warning colour, with a Life Support button. The button opens the Habitat Zones window.
english: Cut the part window's life support block to one line, e.g. "Zone 1 · Lasts 3.0 d · Air", in its warning colour, with a Life Support button. The button opens the Habitat Zones window.
chinese: 将部件窗口中的生命保障块压缩为一行，例如 "1 号区 · 持续 3.0 天 · 空气"，并带有生命保障按钮。点击该按钮可打开居住区窗口。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Habitat header now shows its own stores, e.g. "Habitat: 18 meals · 4 canisters".
english: The Habitat header now shows its own stores, e.g. "Habitat: 18 meals · 4 canisters".
chinese: 居住区标题现在显示其自身的库存，例如 "居住区：18 份餐食 · 4 个吸收罐"。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removed the life support row under TOTAL dV in the vehicle editor and the flight staging panel.
english: Removed the life support row under TOTAL dV in the vehicle editor and the flight staging panel.
chinese: 从载具编辑器和飞行编组面板中移除了位于总 Δv 下方的生命保障行。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: In the editor the crew count it showed is now the first line of Habitat Zones ("3 kittens assigned", or "Assuming 3 kittens (every seat)" when nobody is assigned). In flight that line names the vessel.
english: In the editor the crew count it showed is now the first line of Habitat Zones ("3 kittens assigned", or "Assuming 3 kittens (every seat)" when nobody is assigned). In flight that line names the vessel.
chinese: 在编辑器中，显示的船员数量现在是居住区窗口的第一行（例如 "已分配 3 只喵航员" 或 "假设 3 只喵航员（每个座位一只）"，当无人分配时）。在飞行中，该行显示载具名称。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Renamed the crew portrait SEAT button to MOVE, matching Habitat Zones.
english: Renamed the crew portrait SEAT button to MOVE, matching Habitat Zones.
chinese: 将船员肖像的 SEAT 按钮重命名为 MOVE，以匹配居住区窗口。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Renamed the Habitat Zones window to Life Support in the menus and in the tooltips of the low life support banner, the Resources panel's LIFE SUPPORT block and the part window's Life Support button.
english: Renamed the Habitat Zones window to Life Support in the menus and in the tooltips of the low life support banner, the Resources panel's LIFE SUPPORT block and the part window's Life Support button.
chinese: 在菜单、低生命保障横幅的工具提示、资源面板的生命保障块以及部件窗口的生命保障按钮中，将居住区窗口重命名为生命保障。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Rebuilt the Life Support window around one zone at a time. A tab per zone shows how long that zone lasts, or "no crew" and the window opens on the worst zone. Docked vessels' zones are named after their vessel, e.g. "Zone 2 · Lander".
english: Rebuilt the Life Support window around one zone at a time. A tab per zone shows how long that zone lasts, or "no crew" and the window opens on the worst zone. Docked vessels' zones are named after their vessel, e.g. "Zone 2 · Lander".
chinese: 重建了生命保障窗口，按单个区域进行组织。每个区域的选项卡显示该区域持续的时间，或 "无船员"，窗口会在最差的区域打开。停靠载具的区域以其载具命名，例如 "2 号区 · 着陆器"。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: With the Life Support rule off, tabs show each zone's crew count instead.
english: With the Life Support rule off, tabs show each zone's crew count instead.
chinese: 关闭生命保障规则时，选项卡将显示每个区域的船员数量。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window's header names the vessel and its worst zone, e.g. "Lasts 4.2 d · Air · Zone 1".  In the vehicle editor it shows the kittens assigned, or "Assuming x kittens (every seat)" when nobody is assigned.
english: The Life Support window's header names the vessel and its worst zone, e.g. "Lasts 4.2 d · Air · Zone 1".  In the vehicle editor it shows the kittens assigned, or "Assuming x kittens (every seat)" when nobody is assigned.
chinese: 生命保障窗口的标题显示载具及其最差区域，例如 "持续 4.2 天 · 空气 · 1 号区"。在载具编辑器中，它显示已分配的喵航员，或 "假设 x 只喵航员（每个座位一只）"（当无人分配时）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Each zone's card names the zone, its kittens and how long it will last. Then its habitable volume, volume per kitten and storage on one line. It replaces the separate Habitable, Storage, Stored, Crew and Lasts rows we had before. The card scrolls on its own so the header and zone tabs stay in view.
english: Each zone's card names the zone, its kittens and how long it will last. Then its habitable volume, volume per kitten and storage on one line. It replaces the separate Habitable, Storage, Stored, Crew and Lasts rows we had before. The card scrolls on its own so the header and zone tabs stay in view.
chinese: 每个区域的卡片显示区域名称、其喵航员以及预计持续时间。然后在一行中显示其宜居体积、每只喵航员的体积占用和存储量。它取代了之前的独立宜居空间、存储、已存储物品、船员和持续时间行。卡片会自动滚动，以保持标题和区域选项卡可见。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added supply bars to the Life Support window - Air, Water, Food and CO₂ Scrubber on one time axis so the shortest bar shows what runs out first and by how much. Bars turn amber when low and red when critical using suit warning times on EVA. In breathable air, Air and CO₂ Scrubber read "Breathing outside air".
english: Added supply bars to the Life Support window - Air, Water, Food and CO₂ Scrubber on one time axis so the shortest bar shows what runs out first and by how much. Bars turn amber when low and red when critical using suit warning times on EVA. In breathable air, Air and CO₂ Scrubber read "Breathing outside air".
chinese: 为生命保障窗口添加了供应条 - 空气、水、食物和 CO₂吸收罐，它们共用一个时间轴，最短的条形图显示最先耗尽的项目及其剩余量。当供应较低时变为琥珀色，危急时变为红色，使用 EVA 模式下的宇航服警告时间。在可呼吸空气中，空气和 CO₂吸收罐显示 "正在呼吸外部空气"。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window lists supplies per habitat under Habitats and kittens under Crew with their seat and condition. e.g. "Hungry: 4 h" in the warning colour.
english: The Life Support window lists supplies per habitat under Habitats and kittens under Crew with their seat and condition. e.g. "Hungry: 4 h" in the warning colour.
chinese: 生命保障窗口按居住区列出各处的供应，按船员列出喵航员及其座位号和状态。例如在警告颜色中显示 "饥饿：4 小时"。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Transfer panel to each habitat in the Life Support window replacing the Move button and the To dropdown. It lists every other supply storage on the vessel. Storage in the same zone can be picked to move meals and CO₂ canisters into. Storage behind a closed docking hatch has an Open hatch button beside it, otherwise it is marked as can move via EVA only.
english: Added a Transfer panel to each habitat in the Life Support window replacing the Move button and the To dropdown. It lists every other supply storage on the vessel. Storage in the same zone can be picked to move meals and CO₂ canisters into. Storage behind a closed docking hatch has an Open hatch button beside it, otherwise it is marked as can move via EVA only.
chinese: 为生命保障窗口中的每个居住区添加了转移面板，替换了移动按钮和至下拉菜单。它列出了载具上的所有其他供应存储。同一区域内的存储可以被选中，将餐食和 CO₂吸收罐移入其中。位于关闭对接舱门后的存储旁边有一个打开舱门的按钮，否则标记为仅可通过 EVA 移动。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Transfer shows whenever the vessel has more than one supply storage not only more than one in the same zone.
english: Transfer shows whenever the vessel has more than one supply storage not only more than one in the same zone.
chinese: 转移面板显示载具是否拥有多个供应存储（而不仅仅是同一区域内的多个）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window lists what each zone connects to. Open docking hatches come first, named after the vessels on either side with a Close hatch button. Then the vessel's other zones each either behind a closed hatch, with an Open hatch button, or EVA only.
english: The Life Support window lists what each zone connects to. Open docking hatches come first, named after the vessels on either side with a Close hatch button. Then the vessel's other zones each either behind a closed hatch, with an Open hatch button, or EVA only.
chinese: 生命保障窗口列出每个区域连接的对象。开放的对接舱门排在前面，以两侧载具的名称命名，并带有关闭舱门的按钮。然后是载具的其他区域，每个区域要么位于关闭的舱门后（带有打开舱门的按钮），要么仅可通过 EVA 访问。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Hovering over a zone's tab or card in the Life Support window highlights its parts, hovering a habitat highlights that part, and hovering a hatch or its button highlights both docking ports.
english: Hovering over a zone's tab or card in the Life Support window highlights its parts, hovering a habitat highlights that part, and hovering a hatch or its button highlights both docking ports.
chinese: 在生命保障窗口中悬停在区域的选项卡或卡片上会高亮显示其部件；悬停在居住区上会高亮显示该部件；悬停在舱门或其按钮上会高亮显示两个对接端口。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removed the Highlight all zones and per-zone Highlight checkboxes.
english: Removed the Highlight all zones and per-zone Highlight checkboxes.
chinese: 移除了 "高亮所有区域" 和 "按区域高亮" 复选框。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window switches to the newly controlled vessel when you change vessels, opening on its worst zone. Entering the vehicle editor closes it.
english: The Life Support window switches to the newly controlled vessel when you change vessels, opening on its worst zone. Entering the vehicle editor closes it.
chinese: 当您切换载具时，生命保障窗口会切换到受控的新载具，并打开其最差的居住区。进入车辆编辑器会关闭该窗口。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added EVA Supplies to the View menu while on EVA alongside the existing key.
english: Added EVA Supplies to the View menu while on EVA alongside the existing key.
chinese: 在 EVA 期间，已在视图菜单中添加了 EVA 补给选项，与现有快捷键并列。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Temporarily named the medium capsule "Mk1 Command Pod", the small lander "Mk1 Lander" and the service modules "Mk1 Cargo Bay" (Single, Double, Triple, Quad), so their internal ids no longer show in the Life Support window, seat picker, part window and EVA supplies list.
english: Temporarily named the medium capsule "Mk1 Command Pod", the small lander "Mk1 Lander" and the service modules "Mk1 Cargo Bay" (Single, Double, Triple, Quad), so their internal ids no longer show in the Life Support window, seat picker, part window and EVA supplies list.
chinese: 暂时将中型舱命名为"Mk1 指挥舱"，小型着陆器命名为"Mk1 着陆器"，服务模块命名为"Mk1 货舱"（单、双、三、四），因此其内部 ID 不再显示在生命保障窗口、座位选择器、部件窗口和 EVA 补给列表中。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed vulkan validation error caused by the underwater post process writing to the wrong color format.
english: Fixed vulkan validation error caused by the underwater post process writing to the wrong color format.
chinese: 修复了因水下后期处理写入错误颜色格式而导致的 Vulkan 验证错误。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fix shader reloader crash when reloading the file Lighting.glsl. Associated Vulkan pipelines now request the latest shader instead of an old one. Pipelines in the ClusteredLightSystem are only rebuilt on renderer Rebuild() when shader reloading is turned on so that the Rebuild() isn't slowed down in the normal scenario without shader reloading. There are still a few gaps where shader reloading doesn't work or crashes, but feel free to fix those yourself or ask me to fix them when/if they are needed.
english: Fix shader reloader crash when reloading the file Lighting.glsl. Associated Vulkan pipelines now request the latest shader instead of an old one. Pipelines in the ClusteredLightSystem are only rebuilt on renderer Rebuild() when shader reloading is turned on so that the Rebuild() isn't slowed down in the normal scenario without shader reloading. There are still a few gaps where shader reloading doesn't work or crashes, but feel free to fix those yourself or ask me to fix them when/if they are needed.
chinese: 修复了重新加载 Lighting.glsl 文件时 shader 重载器的崩溃问题。关联的 Vulkan 管线现在请求最新的 shader 而不是旧的。ClusteredLightSystem 中的管线仅在启用 shader 重载时，在渲染器 Rebuild() 期间才重建，以便在没有 shader 重载的正常场景中不会减慢 Rebuild() 的速度。仍然有一些 shader 重载不起作用或崩溃的间隙，但如果您需要，可以自行修复它们或让我修复它们。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Moved the Vessel Ambient Lighting setting from game settings to the Debug menu under View -> Debug -> Lighting -> Vessel Ambient Lighting. This setting is on by default and doesn't need to be in the settings menu.
english: Moved the Vessel Ambient Lighting setting from game settings to the Debug menu under View -> Debug -> Lighting -> Vessel Ambient Lighting. This setting is on by default and doesn't need to be in the settings menu.
chinese: 将 Vessel Ambient Lighting 设置从游戏设置移动到视图 -> 调试 -> 照明 -> 载具环境照明的调试菜单下。该设置默认开启，无需在设置菜单中。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added 1m Structural node piece
english: Added 1m Structural node piece
chinese: 添加了 1m 结构节点部件。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed Radial tanks now use bepu colliders.
english: Changed Radial tanks now use bepu colliders.
chinese: 径向罐现在使用 bepu 碰撞体。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Updated CoreStructuralA_Prefab_StrutCubeNodeHalfWHalfHD.glb and CoreStructuralA_Prefab_StrutCubeNodeHalfWHalfHC.glb.
english: Updated CoreStructuralA_Prefab_StrutCubeNodeHalfWHalfHD.glb and CoreStructuralA_Prefab_StrutCubeNodeHalfWHalfHC.glb.
chinese: 更新了 CoreStructuralA_Prefab_StrutCubeNodeHalfWHalfHD.glb 和 CoreStructuralA_Prefab_StrubtCubeNodeHalfWHalfHC.glb。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added mission plans to vehicle. A plan holds the destination (none, low orbit or a body), whether it flies by orbits or lands, a return trip or one way, how long it stays, and an optional custom length.
english: Added mission plans to vehicle. A plan holds the destination (none, low orbit or a body), whether it flies by orbits or lands, a return trip or one way, how long it stays, and an optional custom length.
chinese: 为载具添加了任务计划。计划包含目的地（无、低轨道或天体）、是否飞掠轨道或着陆、往返行程还是一程、停留时间以及可选的自定义时长。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: It is saved in the vehicle save file and in each launched vehicle's save. A launched vehicle keeps its own copy so editing the craft later never changes a vessel already flying.
english: It is saved in the vehicle save file and in each launched vehicle's save. A launched vehicle keeps its own copy so editing the craft later never changes a vessel already flying.
chinese: 任务计划保存在车辆保存文件中，并保存在每个发射车辆的保存文件中。已发射的车辆保留自己的副本，因此稍后编辑飞船永远不会改变已经飞行的载具。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added mission timing. Each leg is a Hohmann transfer around the common parent of the home planet and the destination plus the legs from a low orbit just above the atmosphere out to a moon's orbit.
english: Added mission timing. Each leg is a Hohmann transfer around the common parent of the home planet and the destination plus the legs from a low orbit just above the atmosphere out to a moon's orbit.
chinese: 任务计时以出发天体和目的天体的共同主天体为中心计算各段霍曼转移，并计入从大气层之上低轨道到卫星轨道等航段。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Trips to another planet wait for the next return window. A short stay becomes the wait for the first window and a longer one rounds up to a later window.  A flyby with a return trip to another planet is refused, as there is no free return.
english: Trips to another planet wait for the next return window. A short stay becomes the wait for the first window and a longer one rounds up to a later window.  A flyby with a return trip to another planet is refused, as there is no free return.
chinese: 行星际往返任务会等待下一次返程窗口。短暂停留将延长至第一个窗口，较长的停留则顺延到之后的窗口。由于没有自由返回轨道，不允许飞掠另一行星后直接返航。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Transfer Planner and the mission timing now share one Hohmann transfer time, one synodic period and one low orbit height.
english: The Transfer Planner and the mission timing now share one Hohmann transfer time, one synodic period and one low orbit height.
chinese: 转移规划器和任务计时现在共享一个霍曼转移时间、一个会合周期和一个低轨道高度。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Mission band to the Life Support window in the vehicle editor. Players can pick a destination, a plan and how long to stay.
english: Added a Mission band to the Life Support window in the vehicle editor. Players can pick a destination, a plan and how long to stay.
chinese: 在车辆编辑器的生命保障窗口中添加了任务带。玩家可以选择目的地、计划以及停留时长。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The life support window then calculates and shows how long the trip will be (we will wire in the life support requirements for the trip later).
english: The life support window then calculates and shows how long the trip will be (we will wire in the life support requirements for the trip later).
chinese: 随后，生命保障窗口计算并显示行程将有多长（我们将稍后为行程接入生命保障需求）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A flyby that returns from another planet asks for Orbit, Land or One way instead.
english: A flyby that returns from another planet asks for Orbit, Land or One way instead.
chinese: 从另一个星球返回的飞掠任务要求选择轨道、着陆或一程。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Custom entry to the Mission band for trips the picker can't describe. It starts from the picker's total and takes a length in days.
english: Added a Custom entry to the Mission band for trips the picker can't describe. It starts from the picker's total and takes a length in days.
chinese: 为任务带添加了自定义条目，用于拾取器无法描述的任务。它从拾取器的总时长开始，并减去天数长度。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Mission changes can be undone and redone in the vehicle editor.
english: Mission changes can be undone and redone in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 任务更改可以在载具编辑器中撤销并重新执行。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Part module lists now use plain arrays that are only allocated when first needed, reducing memory use when placing large symmetry groups in the vehicle editor.
english: Part module lists now use plain arrays that are only allocated when first needed, reducing memory use when placing large symmetry groups in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 部件模块列表现在使用普通数组，仅在首次需要时分配，从而在载具编辑器中放置大型对称组时减少内存占用。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed the test run sometimes aborting with "Test host process crashed". The two Vulkan tests (SimpleShaderStagesOwnershipTests and RenderTechniqueOwnershipTests) were in different xUnit collections so they ran in parallel and creating Vulkan devices on two threads at once crashed the driver.
english: Fixed the test run sometimes aborting with "Test host process crashed". The two Vulkan tests (SimpleShaderStagesOwnershipTests and RenderTechniqueOwnershipTests) were in different xUnit collections so they ran in parallel and creating Vulkan devices on two threads at once crashed the driver.
chinese: 修复了测试运行有时会因"测试主机进程崩溃"而中止的问题。两个 Vulkan 测试（SimpleShaderStagesOwnershipTests 和 RenderTechniqueOwnershipTests）位于不同的 xUnit 集合中，因此并行运行，同时在两个线程上创建 Vulkan 设备导致驱动程序崩溃。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Both are now in a shared "Vulkan" collection so they run one at a time. Any new test that creates a Vulkan device should join it.
english: Both are now in a shared "Vulkan" collection so they run one at a time. Any new test that creates a Vulkan device should join it.
chinese: 两者现在都在一个共享的"Vulkan"集合中，因此一次运行一个。任何创建 Vulkan 设备的测试都应将其加入该集合。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Crew Plan to the Mission band in the vehicle editor's Life Support window.
english: Added a Crew Plan to the Mission band in the vehicle editor's Life Support window.
chinese: 在载具编辑器的生命保障窗口中添加了任务带中的乘员计划。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A zone with no crew plan uses its seated kittens on every leg, or every seat when nobody is assigned. Setting a leg back to the seated count clears the plan, so it follows the seats again.
english: A zone with no crew plan uses its seated kittens on every leg, or every seat when nobody is assigned. Setting a leg back to the seated count clears the plan, so it follows the seats again.
chinese: 没有乘员计划的居住区会在每个航段使用其就座的喵航员，或者当没有人被分配时，在每个座位使用。将某个航段重置为就座数量会清除该计划，使其再次遵循座位数。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The crew plan is saved with the vehicle on each zone's lead habitat part.
english: The crew plan is saved with the vehicle on each zone's lead habitat part.
chinese: 乘员计划与载具一起保存在每个居住区的引导栖息部分上。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: With a mission picked the Life Support window checks each zone's supplies against its crew plan. The supply bars are drawn on the mission's timeline, with lines where each leg starts and a dashed "last leg ends" line. Kittens per leg are shown under the axis. A bar is green if it lasts past the zone's last leg and amber if it runs out first. Each supply that runs short gets a line of text.
english: With a mission picked the Life Support window checks each zone's supplies against its crew plan. The supply bars are drawn on the mission's timeline, with lines where each leg starts and a dashed "last leg ends" line. Kittens per leg are shown under the axis. A bar is green if it lasts past the zone's last leg and amber if it runs out first. Each supply that runs short gets a line of text.
chinese: 选择任务后，生命保障窗口检查每个居住区的供应品与其乘员计划的对比。供应条绘制在任务的时线上，在每条航段开始处有线条，并在"最后航段结束"处有虚线。每条航段的喵航员数量显示在轴下方。如果供应品持续超过该居住区的最后航段，则显示为绿色；如果先耗尽，则显示为琥珀色。每种短缺的供应品都会有一行文本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Air and water are counted from the vessel's tanks against every kitten aboard on each leg. Food and CO₂ canisters are counted from the zone's own habitats against that zone's kittens. A zone's supplies start draining on its first crewed leg.
english: Air and water are counted from the vessel's tanks against every kitten aboard on each leg. Food and CO₂ canisters are counted from the zone's own habitats against that zone's kittens. A zone's supplies start draining on its first crewed leg.
chinese: 各航段按全船乘员数从共用储罐计算空气和水。各区的餐食和 CO₂ 吸收罐按本区乘员数计算，从本区第一个载人航段起开始消耗。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: In mission mode the window header reads "Enough for the mission" or "Air short by 4.8 d · Zone 1". Each zone tab reads "enough", "short x d" or "not used" and the window opens on the zone that is shortest.
english: In mission mode the window header reads "Enough for the mission" or "Air short by 4.8 d · Zone 1". Each zone tab reads "enough", "short x d" or "not used" and the window opens on the zone that is shortest.
chinese: 在任务模式下，窗口标题显示"足以完成整个任务"或"空气短缺 4.8 d · 区域 1"。每个区域标签显示"充足"、"短缺 x d"或"未使用"，并且窗口会打开在最短的区域上。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: In mission mode a zone's card counts kittens from the crew plan. The per-kitten habitable volume uses the busiest leg.
english: In mission mode a zone's card counts kittens from the crew plan. The per-kitten habitable volume uses the busiest leg.
chinese: 在任务模式下，区域的卡片根据乘员计划计算喵航员数量。每只喵航员的宜居体积使用最繁忙的航段。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tooltips across the Life Support window
english: Added tooltips across the Life Support window
chinese: 为生命保障窗口添加了提示文本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Aded ConsoleWidgets.ItemTooltip and WrappedTooltip.
english: Aded ConsoleWidgets.ItemTooltip and WrappedTooltip.
chinese: 添加了 ConsoleWidgets.ItemTooltip 和 WrappedTooltip。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the crew plan.
english: Added unit tests for the crew plan.
chinese: 为乘员计划添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a second-order position filter and maximum rate limit to all engine gimbals. Engines will no longer instantly change direction in response to commands - they will have inertia and require time to readjust. This adds meaningful delays to TVC control, so using RATE mode is now generally recommended over MANUAL where possible.
english: Added a second-order position filter and maximum rate limit to all engine gimbals. Engines will no longer instantly change direction in response to commands - they will have inertia and require time to readjust. This adds meaningful delays to TVC control, so using RATE mode is now generally recommended over MANUAL where possible.
chinese: 为所有发动机稳定器添加了二阶位置滤波器和最大速率限制。发动机将不再根据命令瞬间改变方向——它们将具有惯性并需要时间来调整。这为 TVC 控制增加了有意义的延迟，因此在使用 RATE 模式时，在可能的情况下通常推荐使用它而不是 MANUAL 模式。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Upgraded the flight computer TVC controller to handle the new dynamics introduced by finite-rate gimbals.
english: Upgraded the flight computer TVC controller to handle the new dynamics introduced by finite-rate gimbals.
chinese: 升级了飞行计算机的 TVC 控制器以处理有限速率稳定器引入的新动态。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Life Support tooltips with numbers in them now format into their own 1,024-character buffer instead of a shared 128 or 256-character one.
english: Life Support tooltips with numbers in them now format into their own 1,024-character buffer instead of a shared 128 or 256-character one.
chinese: 包含数字的生命保障提示文本现在格式化为它们自己的 1,024 字符缓冲区，而不是共享的 128 或 256 字符缓冲区。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Stock for mission button to each zone in the vehicle editors Life Support window once a mission is picked.
english: Added a Stock for mission button to each zone in the vehicle editors Life Support window once a mission is picked.
chinese: 在载具编辑器的生命保障窗口中为每个区域添加了"任务模式下添加供应品"按钮（选择任务后）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: It sets the zone's meals and CO₂ canisters to cover its crew plan plus a margin, as far as the zone's storage allows.
english: It sets the zone's meals and CO₂ canisters to cover its crew plan plus a margin, as far as the zone's storage allows.
chinese: 它设置居住区的餐食和 CO₂吸收罐，以覆盖该区域乘员计划加上余量，只要该区域的存储空间允许即可。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Habitats are filled in order and any locker the zone doesn't need is emptied so stocking also takes off unneeded supplies and their mass.
english: Habitats are filled in order and any locker the zone doesn't need is emptied so stocking also takes off unneeded supplies and their mass.
chinese: 栖息地按顺序填充，任何该区域不需要的储物柜会被清空，因此补给也会移除多余的物资及其质量。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Stock all button to the Mission band that stocks every crewed zone at once.
english: Added a Stock all button to the Mission band that stocks every crewed zone at once.
chinese: 在任务条中添加了“全部补给”按钮，可一次性为所有载人区域进行补给。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Stocking can be undone in the vehicle editor.
english: Stocking can be undone in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 在载具编辑器中可以撤销补给操作。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: When a zone's storage can't hold what the mission needs its card's text says how much more storage it needs.
english: When a zone's storage can't hold what the mission needs its card's text says how much more storage it needs.
chinese: 当区域的存储空间无法容纳任务所需物品时，其卡片文本会说明还需要多少存储空间。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Mission band displays when the vessel's air or water tanks fall short of the mission plus the margin.
english: The Mission band displays when the vessel's air or water tanks fall short of the mission plus the margin.
chinese: 任务条显示当飞船的空气或水箱低于任务需求加上余量时。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Air and water aren't stocked by the button because they come from tanks. The air line is hidden in breathable air.
english: Air and water aren't stocked by the button because they come from tanks. The air line is hidden in breathable air.
chinese: 空气和水不会通过按钮进行补给，因为它们来自水箱。空气线路在可呼吸空气中隐藏。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Stock for Mission Margin player setting under Settings > Simulation > Life Support, from 0 to 100%, default is 20%.
english: Added a Stock for Mission Margin player setting under Settings > Simulation > Life Support, from 0 to 100%, default is 20%.
chinese: 在“设置 > 模拟 > 生命保障”下添加了“任务余量”玩家设置中的“补给”，范围从 0% 到 100%，默认值为 20%。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests  for above.
english: Added unit tests  for above.
chinese: 为上述内容添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a supplies check when launching a vehicle with a mission from the vehicle editor or the launch menu.
english: Added a supplies check when launching a vehicle with a mission from the vehicle editor or the launch menu.
chinese: 在载具编辑器或发射菜单中从载具发射带有任务的飞船时，添加了物资检查。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: With the Life Support rule on, if any zone's supplies run out before its last mission leg ends, a "Not enough supplies" prompt names the zone furthest short, the supply that runs out first, how long it lasts and when the zone's last leg ends.
english: With the Life Support rule on, if any zone's supplies run out before its last mission leg ends, a "Not enough supplies" prompt names the zone furthest short, the supply that runs out first, how long it lasts and when the zone's last leg ends.
chinese: 开启生命保障规则后，如果任何区域的物资在最后一个航段结束前耗尽，会弹出“物资不足”提示，命名最短缺的区域、最先耗尽的物资类型、持续时间和该区域最后一个航段的结束时间。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Launch anyway?" With no mission set or the life support rule off, launching works as it did before.
english: Launch anyway?" With no mission set or the life support rule off, launching works as it did before.
chinese: "无论如何发射？"在没有设置任务或生命保障规则关闭的情况下，发射按之前的方式工作。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The "No crew assigned" prompt still comes first and the supplies check follows it.
english: The "No crew assigned" prompt still comes first and the supplies check follows it.
chinese: "未分配船员"提示仍然首先出现，随后是物资检查。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Both launch buttons now share one launch check replacing two copies of the no-crew prompt.
english: Both launch buttons now share one launch check replacing two copies of the no-crew prompt.
chinese: 两个发射按钮现在共享一个发射检查，取代了两个“无船员”提示副本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the launch check.
english: Added unit tests for the launch check.
chinese: 为发射检查添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added initial kFS core library and tests
english: Added initial kFS core library and tests
chinese: 添加了初始 kFS 核心库和测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removed kFS 1s compile test time limit, works locally but was failing on busy CI runner
english: Removed kFS 1s compile test time limit, works locally but was failing on busy CI runner
chinese: 移除了 kFS 1 秒编译时间限制，本地工作正常但繁忙的 CI 运行器上会失败。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added mission tracking in flight. With a mission set and the Life Support rule on the Life Support window now checks each zone's supplies against what's left of the mission.
english: Added mission tracking in flight. With a mission set and the Life Support rule on the Life Support window now checks each zone's supplies against what's left of the mission.
chinese: 添加了飞行中的任务跟踪。设置了任务并开启生命保障规则后，生命保障窗口现在检查每个区域的物资与剩余任务时间的对比。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a "Mission timing" switch to the Life Support window in flight. As planned (the default) times the mission's legs as planned in the editor, counted from launch.
english: Added a "Mission timing" switch to the Life Support window in flight. As planned (the default) times the mission's legs as planned in the editor, counted from launch.
chinese: 在飞行中，生命保障窗口新增了"任务计时"开关。按计划（默认）设置航段时间，从发射开始计算。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: **** This is a primitive clock counter for now but later we will add actual mission destination logs and tracking.
english: **** This is a primitive clock counter for now but later we will add actual mission destination logs and tracking.
chinese: **** 目前这是一个原始时钟计数器，稍后我们将添加实际的任务目的地日志和追踪功能。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: From flight plan takes the arrival from when the flight plan reaches the mission's destination then adds the planned stay and the trip home.
english: From flight plan takes the arrival from when the flight plan reaches the mission's destination then adds the planned stay and the trip home.
chinese: 从飞行计划中获取到达时间：当飞行计划抵达任务目的地时，再加上计划的停留时间和归程行程。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: From flight plan is greyed out when the mission has no destination body or the flight plan doesn't reach it.
english: From flight plan is greyed out when the mission has no destination body or the flight plan doesn't reach it.
chinese: 当任务没有目标天体或飞行计划无法抵达该天体时，"从飞行计划"选项会呈灰色禁用状态。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A label beside the switch shows how much of the mission is left after which the window goes back to its normal forecast.
english: A label beside the switch shows how much of the mission is left after which the window goes back to its normal forecast.
chinese: 开关旁的标签显示剩余多少任务时间后，窗口将恢复至其正常的预测模式。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A vessel now records when it reaches and leaves its mission's destination and From flight plan uses those real times. A stay that runs over keeps the whole trip home until the vessel leaves.
english: A vessel now records when it reaches and leaves its mission's destination and From flight plan uses those real times. A stay that runs over keeps the whole trip home until the vessel leaves.
chinese: 载具现在会记录抵达和离开任务目的地的真实时间，"从飞行计划"使用这些真实时间。若停留时间超过预期，则保持整个归程行程直到载具离开。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A vessel split off by decoupling or undocking keeps a copy of the mission so a lander's zone still shows its mission timeline.
english: A vessel split off by decoupling or undocking keeps a copy of the mission so a lander's zone still shows its mission timeline.
chinese: 通过解耦或分离分出的载具会保留一份任务副本，因此着陆区的居住区仍会显示其任务时间线。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: In flight the supply warnings read "runs out in" rather than "runs out at", and the Stock for mission buttons only appears in the vehicle editor.
english: In flight the supply warnings read "runs out in" rather than "runs out at", and the Stock for mission buttons only appears in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 在飞行中，供应品警告现在显示"将在...耗尽"而非"将于...耗尽"，且任务的"供应品"按钮仅在载具编辑器中出现。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Transfer Planner Window when opened now opens with the vessel's mission destination automatically set.
english: The Transfer Planner Window when opened now opens with the vessel's mission destination automatically set.
chinese: 打开转移规划窗口时，会自动设置载具的任务目的地。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Transfer Planner's life support line checks the whole rest of the mission with the selected transfer's arrival.
english: The Transfer Planner's life support line checks the whole rest of the mission with the selected transfer's arrival.
chinese: 转移规划器的生命保障行会检查整个剩余任务时间，并与所选转移的到达时间进行对比。
