notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: After the vessel has arrived, a transfer back to the home planet is checked as the trip home.
english: After the vessel has arrived, a transfer back to the home planet is checked as the trip home.
chinese: 载具抵达后，会检查返回母星的归程行程。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: When the selected transfer goes to a different body than the mission, the Transfer Planner shows both destinations with an Update Mission button that makes this transfer's body the mission's destination.
english: When the selected transfer goes to a different body than the mission, the Transfer Planner shows both destinations with an Update Mission button that makes this transfer's body the mission's destination.
chinese: 当所选转移前往与任务不同的天体时，转移规划器会显示两个目的地，并提供"更新任务"按钮，使该转移的天体成为任务目的地。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: When a transfer reaches the mission's destination a day or more later than planned the Transfer Planner shows the same comparison without the button.
english: When a transfer reaches the mission's destination a day or more later than planned the Transfer Planner shows the same comparison without the button.
chinese: 当转移比计划晚一天或更多时间抵达任务目的地时，转移规划器会显示相同的对比结果但不包含按钮。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tooltips for the Mission timing switch and the new Transfer Planner lines.
english: Added tooltips for the Mission timing switch and the new Transfer Planner lines.
chinese: 为"任务计时"开关和新的转移规划行添加了提示文本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reduced the frame stall when dropping, detaching or duplicating large groups of parts in the vehicle editor.
english: Reduced the frame stall when dropping, detaching or duplicating large groups of parts in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 在载具编辑器中丢弃、分离或复制大量部件时的帧卡顿已减少。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Solid rocket motor thrust curves are no longer recalculated twice after each change in the vehicle editor.
english: Solid rocket motor thrust curves are no longer recalculated twice after each change in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 载具编辑器中的固体火箭发动机推力曲线不再每次更改后重复计算两次。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Recording undo steps in the vehicle editor is faster on vehicles with many parts.
english: Recording undo steps in the vehicle editor is faster on vehicles with many parts.
chinese: 在拥有许多部件的载具上，记录撤销步骤的速度更快。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Duplicating large groups of parts no longer calculates their bounding boxes twice.
english: Duplicating large groups of parts no longer calculates their bounding boxes twice.
chinese: 不再重复计算大型部件组的边界框。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added two placeholder habitat modules under the Life Support editor tag. They use the fuel tank meshes until they get their own art.
english: Added two placeholder habitat modules under the Life Support editor tag. They use the fuel tank meshes until they get their own art.
chinese: 在生命保障编辑器标签下添加了两个占位符居住区模块。它们在使用自己的美术资源前使用燃料罐网格。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: HM-2 Habitat Module is 2 m wide and 4 m long, with 12.47 m³ inside: 6.23 m³ habitable and 6.23 m³ storage.
english: HM-2 Habitat Module is 2 m wide and 4 m long, with 12.47 m³ inside: 6.23 m³ habitable and 6.23 m³ storage.
chinese: HM-2 居住区模块宽 2 米，长 4 米，内部容积 12.47 立方米：其中 6.23 立方米为居住区，6.23 立方米为存储区。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: HM-3 Habitat Module is 3 m wide and 6 m long, with 42.19 m³ inside: 21.09 m³ habitable and 21.09 m³ storage.
english: HM-3 Habitat Module is 3 m wide and 6 m long, with 42.19 m³ inside: 21.09 m³ habitable and 21.09 m³ storage.
chinese: HM-3 居住区模块宽 3 米，长 6 米，内部容积 42.19 立方米：其中 21.09 立方米为居住区，21.09 立方米为存储区。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Neither module has seatsthes, so kittens move in from a crewed part in the same zone.
english: Neither module has seatsthes, so kittens move in from a crewed part in the same zone.
chinese: 这两个模块都没有座位，因此喵航员会从同一区域内的载人部件中移动过来。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a storm shelter to the HM-2 and HM-3 Habitat Modules: a 20 g/cm² polyethylene liner around the seats. Over the bare wall it cuts a solar storm from 85% to 1.2% getting through, belt protons from 91% to 7.5% and cosmic rays from 96% to 62%.
english: Added a storm shelter to the HM-2 and HM-3 Habitat Modules: a 20 g/cm² polyethylene liner around the seats. Over the bare wall it cuts a solar storm from 85% to 1.2% getting through, belt protons from 91% to 7.5% and cosmic rays from 96% to 62%.
chinese: 为 HM-2 和 HM-3 居住区模块添加了风暴掩体：座位周围有一层 20 g/cm²的聚乙烯内衬。在裸露墙壁上，它能将穿过太阳风暴的能量从 85% 降至 1.2%，将束质子从 91% 降至 7.5%，将宇宙射线从 96% 降至 62%。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The shelter adds 2,036 kg to the HM-2 and 3,619 kg to the HM-3.
english: The shelter adds 2,036 kg to the HM-2 and 3,619 kg to the HM-3.
chinese: 掩体为 HM-2 增加了 2,036 kg，为 HM-3 增加了 3,619 kg。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added 2 seats to the HM-2 and 4 seats to the HM-3. A kitten is shielded only while seated in a module, so move the crew in when a solar storm hits.
english: Added 2 seats to the HM-2 and 4 seats to the HM-3. A kitten is shielded only while seated in a module, so move the crew in when a solar storm hits.
chinese: 为 HM-2 添加了 2 个座位，为 HM-3 添加了 4 个座位。喵航员只有在坐在模块内时才受保护，因此当太阳风暴来袭时请移动船员。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a placeholder texture: sand coloured with faint stripes. It marks parts that borrow another part's meshes. The fuel tank's normal and roughness maps keep the panel detail.
english: Added a placeholder texture: sand coloured with faint stripes. It marks parts that borrow another part's meshes. The fuel tank's normal and roughness maps keep the panel detail.
chinese: 添加了一个占位符纹理：带有微弱条纹的沙色。它标记了借用其他部件网格的部件。燃料罐的法线和粗糙度贴图保留了面板细节。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The SL-M1 and SL-M2 Supply Lockers now use the placeholder texture on their bay tank, truss, support and piping meshes, so they no longer look like fuel tanks.
english: The SL-M1 and SL-M2 Supply Lockers now use the placeholder texture on their bay tank, truss, support and piping meshes, so they no longer look like fuel tanks.
chinese: SL-M1 和 SL-M2 供应柜现在在其舱室罐、桁架、支撑和管道网格上使用占位符纹理，因此它们不再看起来像燃料罐。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added TilingColor modifier. It follows the TilingDetail height modifier. I might merge this into one modifier in the future so they always match if it's worth keeping around.
english: Added TilingColor modifier. It follows the TilingDetail height modifier. I might merge this into one modifier in the future so they always match if it's worth keeping around.
chinese: 添加了 TilingColor 修饰器。它遵循 TilingDetail 高度修饰器。未来如果值得保留，我可能会将其合并为一个修饰器以确保它们始终匹配。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added procedural modifier profiler tags.
english: Added procedural modifier profiler tags.
chinese: 添加了过程化修饰器分析器标签。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added detail colour variation to Earth's grasslands and desert mountains.
english: Added detail colour variation to Earth's grasslands and desert mountains.
chinese: 为地球的草原和沙漠山脉添加了细节色彩变化。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added ground and slope colouration to the simple craters and ejecta craters modifiers.
english: Added ground and slope colouration to the simple craters and ejecta craters modifiers.
chinese: 为简单的陨石坑和溅射物陨石坑修饰器添加了地面和坡度着色。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added colouration to the Moon's craters.
english: Added colouration to the Moon's craters.
chinese: 为月球陨石坑添加了着色。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed sand dunes becoming unstable when approaching the shear threshold.
english: Fixed sand dunes becoming unstable when approaching the shear threshold.
chinese: 修复了沙丘在接近剪切阈值时变得不稳定的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Prevented setting sand dune shear outside [0, 1].
english: Prevented setting sand dune shear outside [0, 1].
chinese: 防止将沙丘剪切值设置在 [0, 1] 之外。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added detail colouration to Mars. Sand dunes are slightly darker and used some basic simplex noise to add minor colour variation to the surface in all biomes.
english: Added detail colouration to Mars. Sand dunes are slightly darker and used some basic simplex noise to add minor colour variation to the surface in all biomes.
chinese: 为火星添加了细节色彩变化。沙丘略暗，并使用简单的单色噪声在所有生物群系中为表面添加微小的色彩变化。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed terrain modifier colour blending not being done in premultiplied space.
english: Fixed terrain modifier colour blending not being done in premultiplied space.
chinese: 修复了 premultiplied space 中地形修饰颜色混合未执行的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed erosion modifier colour params being mislabeled.
english: Fixed erosion modifier colour params being mislabeled.
chinese: 修复了侵蚀修饰颜色参数标签错误的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a colour persistence param to the erosion modifier.
english: Added a colour persistence param to the erosion modifier.
chinese: 为侵蚀修饰添加了颜色持久性参数。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Moved simplex noise permutation tables to a hash, which improves simplex performance by around 7x on NVIDIA. Won't affect AMD performance (does not have the performance penalty that comes from storing the perm table in constant memory). I considered shared memory but it was just as fast and limited the noise library to compute shaders.
english: Moved simplex noise permutation tables to a hash, which improves simplex performance by around 7x on NVIDIA. Won't affect AMD performance (does not have the performance penalty that comes from storing the perm table in constant memory). I considered shared memory but it was just as fast and limited the noise library to compute shaders.
chinese: 将 simplex noise 置换表移至哈希函数中，在 NVIDIA 上使 simplex 性能提升约 7 倍。不会影响 AMD 性能（因为存储置换表在常量内存中会产生性能惩罚）。曾考虑使用共享内存，但速度相同且限制了噪声库仅能用于计算着色器。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removed unused 4D simplex noises.
english: Removed unused 4D simplex noises.
chinese: 移除了未使用的 4D simplex noise。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed complex crater noises mismatching between value and gradient versions.
english: Fixed complex crater noises mismatching between value and gradient versions.
chinese: 修复了复杂陨石坑噪声在值版本和梯度版本之间不匹配的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed simplex noise stacking on itself when lacunarity = 2 (which is what most modifiers used) by applying an offset to the cell hash.
english: Fixed simplex noise stacking on itself when lacunarity = 2 (which is what most modifiers used) by applying an offset to the cell hash.
chinese: 修复了当 lacunarity = 2（大多数修饰符使用此值）时，simplex noise 自身堆叠的问题，通过向单元哈希应用偏移量来解决。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Revised launch site decal altitude offsets.
english: Revised launch site decal altitude offsets.
chinese: 修订了发射场 decals 的高度偏移。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Improved erosion performance by around 20% using a cheaper hash.
english: Improved erosion performance by around 20% using a cheaper hash.
chinese: 通过使用更便宜的哈希，将侵蚀性能提高了约 20%。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removed some unused simplex functions.
english: Removed some unused simplex functions.
chinese: 移除了部分未使用的 simplex 函数。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Optimized CPU and GPU erosion reducing the cost by around 50% by using 4 simplex corners instead of 8.
english: Optimized CPU and GPU erosion reducing the cost by around 50% by using 4 simplex corners instead of 8.
chinese: 优化 CPU 和 GPU 侵蚀，通过改用 4 个 simplex corner 代替 8 个，成本降低了约 50%。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Improved Mars' biome distribution.
english: Improved Mars' biome distribution.
chinese: 改进了火星的生物群分布。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed Mars' debris diffuse texture being extremely dark and creating a sudden transition between biomes.
english: Fixed Mars' debris diffuse texture being extremely dark and creating a sudden transition between biomes.
chinese: 修复了火星碎片漫反射纹理过暗，导致生物群之间出现突然过渡的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed biome map exporter not accounting for equirectangular distortion when generating the biome ID and control maps.
english: Fixed biome map exporter not accounting for equirectangular distortion when generating the biome ID and control maps.
chinese: 修复了生物群地图导出器在生成生物群 ID 和控制图时未考虑等距圆柱投影畸变的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed some launch sites being too low.
english: Fixed some launch sites being too low.
chinese: 修复了部分发射站过低的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Removing the stock GNC subblocks from kFS until interfaces are established
english: Removing the stock GNC subblocks from kFS until interfaces are established
chinese: 从 kFS 中移除 stock GNC subblocks，直到接口建立完成。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Parts can now be radially attached to the HM-2 and HM-3 Habitat Modules.
english: Parts can now be radially attached to the HM-2 and HM-3 Habitat Modules.
chinese: 部件现在可以径向连接到 HM-2 和 HM-3 Habitat Modules。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Mission section to the Launch menu for craft with a saved mission. It shows the mission, whether the supplies last, and the zone that runs shortest and which supply runs out first.
english: Added a Mission section to the Launch menu for craft with a saved mission. It shows the mission, whether the supplies last, and the zone that runs shortest and which supply runs out first.
chinese: 为带有保存任务的载具在发射菜单中添加了 Mission section。显示任务、补给是否够用、运行最短的 zone 以及最先耗尽的补给。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Stock All button to the Launch menu. It fills meals, CO₂ canisters and the air and water tanks for this launch only and doesn't change the saved craft.
english: Added a Stock All button to the Launch menu. It fills meals, CO₂ canisters and the air and water tanks for this launch only and doesn't change the saved craft.
chinese: 在发射菜单中添加了“全部补给”按钮。它仅针对本次发射填充餐食、CO₂吸收罐以及空气和水储罐，且不会更改已保存的载具。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added an Open in Editor button to the Launch menu when supplies are short. It opens the saved craft in the vehicle editor. Crew and stocking picked in the Launch menu are not carried into the Vehicle Editor.
english: Added an Open in Editor button to the Launch menu when supplies are short. It opens the saved craft in the vehicle editor. Crew and stocking picked in the Launch menu are not carried into the Vehicle Editor.
chinese: 当补给不足时，在发射菜单中添加了“在编辑器中打开”按钮。它将打开已保存的载具进入车辆编辑器。在发射菜单中选择的人员和补给不会带入车辆编辑器。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The "Not enough supplies" launch prompt now has Stock for Mission, Open in Editor, Launch Anyway and Cancel.
english: The "Not enough supplies" launch prompt now has Stock for Mission, Open in Editor, Launch Anyway and Cancel.
chinese: "补给不足"的发射提示现在包含：为任务补给、在编辑器中打开、无论如何发射和取消。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Stock for Mission in the launch prompt only appears when stocking can fix the shortfall. It stocks the launch, checks again and launches if there's now enough.
english: Stock for Mission in the launch prompt only appears when stocking can fix the shortfall. It stocks the launch, checks again and launches if there's now enough.
chinese: 发射提示中的“为任务补给”仅在补给能弥补短缺时才会显示。它将执行本次发射的补给，再次检查，如果此时补给已足够则发射。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added air and water lines to the mission band in the editor's Life Support window. Each shows what the tanks hold now, what they hold when full and what the mission plus the life support margin needs.
english: Added air and water lines to the mission band in the editor's Life Support window. Each shows what the tanks hold now, what they hold when full and what the mission plus the life support margin needs.
chinese: 已在编辑器的生命保障窗口中向任务带添加了空气和水线路。每条线分别显示当前储罐储量、满储状态以及任务加生命保障余量所需的储量。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: When even full tanks can't cover the mission the air or water line says how much more is needed and to add a tank with its Role Affinity set to that supply.
english: When even full tanks can't cover the mission the air or water line says how much more is needed and to add a tank with its Role Affinity set to that supply.
chinese: 即使满罐也无法覆盖任务时，空气或水线路会说明还需要多少，并提示添加一个角色亲和性设置为该补给类型的储罐。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Hovering an air or water line highlights the tanks it counts.
english: Hovering an air or water line highlights the tanks it counts.
chinese: 悬停在空气或水线上方会高亮显示其计入的储罐。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Fill Air and Water button to the mission band. It tops the tanks up to the mission requirement plus the margin, or to full when that isn't enough. Tanks are never emptied.
english: Added a Fill Air and Water button to the mission band. It tops the tanks up to the mission requirement plus the margin, or to full when that isn't enough. Tanks are never emptied.
chinese: 已在任务带中添加了“填充空气和水”按钮。它将储罐加满至任务需求加余量，或在无法达到此数值时加至满储。储罐永远不会被排空。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Stock All now fills the air and water tanks as well as meals and canisters.
english: Stock All now fills the air and water tanks as well as meals and canisters.
chinese: "全部补给"现在也会填充空气和水储罐，而不仅仅是餐食和吸收罐。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The pre-launch supplies check now counts air and water in the tanks.
english: The pre-launch supplies check now counts air and water in the tanks.
chinese: 发射前的补给检查现在会计算储罐中的空气和水。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tooltips for the new Launch menu and mission band buttons and lines.
english: Added tooltips for the new Launch menu and mission band buttons and lines.
chinese: 已为新发射菜单和任务带按钮及线路添加了提示文本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a new lookup table to the kitten roster which speeds up finding a kitten in the roster which every crewed vessel does for each seat every frame.
english: Added a new lookup table to the kitten roster which speeds up finding a kitten in the roster which every crewed vessel does for each seat every frame.
chinese: 已在喵员名册中添加了新的查找表，加速了每帧每个座位为每艘载人载具查找喵员的性能（此前所有载人载具均执行此操作）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the roster lookup.
english: Added unit tests for the roster lookup.
chinese: 已为喵员名册查找功能添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Life support, mission and power times are now stored as UniverseTime instead of doubles.
english: Life support, mission and power times are now stored as UniverseTime instead of doubles.
chinese: 生命保障、任务和时间功率时间现在以宇宙时间存储，而非双精度浮点数。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A kitten's time without each supply and a mission's stay, length, arrival and departure are now saved as UniverseTimeReference elements.
english: A kitten's time without each supply and a mission's stay, length, arrival and departure are now saved as UniverseTimeReference elements.
chinese: 喵员在每种补给下的存活时间及任务的停留时长、长度、到达和离开时间现在保存为宇宙时间参考元素。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests.
english: Added unit tests.
chinese: 已添加单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Crew Clock under the game time gauge. It shows the next thing that happens to a kitten if nothing changes. It covers every crewed vessel and kitten on EVA not just the one you control.
english: Added a Crew Clock under the game time gauge. It shows the next thing that happens to a kitten if nothing changes. It covers every crewed vessel and kitten on EVA not just the one you control.
chinese: 在游戏时间计表下方添加了“乘员倒计时”。它显示如果没有任何变化，下一个发生在喵员身上的事件。它涵盖所有载人载具和 EVA 中的喵员，而不仅仅是您控制的船只。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Within a day of each other the worst event comes first: dying before incapacitated before degraded. Further out the soonest shows first.
english: Within a day of each other the worst event comes first: dying before incapacitated before degraded. Further out the soonest shows first.
chinese: 在一天内，最糟糕的事件首先发生：死亡、丧失行动能力、退化。更远的地方，最早显示的是第一个。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Events are amber when a kitten will be degraded and red when it will be incapacitated or die.
english: Events are amber when a kitten will be degraded and red when it will be incapacitated or die.
chinese: 当喵航员将退化时，事件为琥珀色；当它将丧失行动能力或死亡时，事件为红色。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a +/− button to the Crew Clock. It switches between showing only the most urgent event and showing the next event for every vessel. The full list scrolls after 8 vessels.
english: Added a +/− button to the Crew Clock. It switches between showing only the most urgent event and showing the next event for every vessel. The full list scrolls after 8 vessels.
chinese: 在乘员倒计时中添加了 +/− 按钮。它在仅显示最紧急事件和显示每艘载具的下一个事件之间切换。完整列表在 8 艘载具后滚动。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Clicking an event in the Crew Clock takes control of that vessel. If it's the vessel you already control it opens the Life Support window.
english: Clicking an event in the Crew Clock takes control of that vessel. If it's the vessel you already control it opens the Life Support window.
chinese: 点击乘员倒计时中的事件将控制该载具。如果是您已经控制的载具，它将打开生命保障窗口。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a "Back to" button to the Crew Clock and the Life Support window. It returns control to the vessel you were controlling before you switched.
english: Added a "Back to" button to the Crew Clock and the Life Support window. It returns control to the vessel you were controlling before you switched.
chinese: 在乘员倒计时和生命保障窗口中添加了“返回”按钮。它将控制权返回到您切换前正在控制的载具。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added Crew Clock to the View menu with the Ctrl+F6 key binding so you can turn it on or off. Whether it's shown and whether it's collapsed are saved in your settings.
english: Added Crew Clock to the View menu with the Ctrl+F6 key binding so you can turn it on or off. Whether it's shown and whether it's collapsed are saved in your settings.
chinese: 在查看菜单中添加了乘员倒计时，并绑定 Ctrl+F6 键，以便您可以将其开启或关闭。是否显示以及是否折叠会保存在您的设置中。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window in flight now lists the next event for every vessel at the top. Clicking one works the same as in the Crew Clock and hovering one highlights the zone.
english: The Life Support window in flight now lists the next event for every vessel at the top. Clicking one works the same as in the Crew Clock and hovering one highlights the zone.
chinese: 飞行中的生命保障窗口现在在顶部列出每艘载具的下一个事件。点击一个与在乘员倒计时中操作相同，悬停在一个上会高亮显示区域。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window in flight now has a tab for each crewed vessel. Each tab shows how long that vessel's worst zone lasts coloured by its supply level. Selecting a tab shows that vessel without taking control of it.
english: The Life Support window in flight now has a tab for each crewed vessel. Each tab shows how long that vessel's worst zone lasts coloured by its supply level. Selecting a tab shows that vessel without taking control of it.
chinese: 飞行中的生命保障窗口现在为每艘有船员的载具提供了一个选项卡。每个选项卡显示该载具的最糟糕区域持续多长时间，并根据其供应水平着色。选择一个选项卡会显示该载具而不会控制它。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a Switch To button next to the vessel name in the Life Support window when the vessel shown isn't the one you control.
english: Added a Switch To button next to the vessel name in the Life Support window when the vessel shown isn't the one you control.
chinese: 在生命保障窗口中，当显示的载具不是您控制的载具时，在载具名称旁边添加了“切换至”按钮。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tooltips for the Crew Clock, its buttons, the vessel tabs and the Switch To button.
english: Added tooltips for the Crew Clock, its buttons, the vessel tabs and the Switch To button.
chinese: 为乘员倒计时、其按钮、载具选项卡和“切换至”按钮添加了提示文本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for all of the above and added a benchmark for the cost per frame with 100, 300 and 1000 vessels.
english: Added unit tests for all of the above and added a benchmark for the cost per frame with 100, 300 and 1000 vessels.
chinese: 为上述所有内容添加了单元测试，并添加了每帧成本基准测试，分别使用 100、300 和 1000 艘载具。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed updated CoreCommandB Textures, Coupling and FuelTank Textures.
english: Changed updated CoreCommandB Textures, Coupling and FuelTank Textures.
chinese: 更新了 CoreCommandB 纹理、耦合和燃料罐纹理。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Crew Clock and the Life Support window now show when a kitten will get radiation sickness or die from its radiation dose.
english: The Crew Clock and the Life Support window now show when a kitten will get radiation sickness or die from its radiation dose.
chinese: 现在乘员倒计时和生命保障窗口会显示喵航员何时会患上辐射病或因辐射剂量死亡。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Crew Clock is now available when either the Life Support or the Radiation rule is on.
english: The Crew Clock is now available when either the Life Support or the Radiation rule is on.
chinese: 当“生命保障”或“辐射”规则启用时，乘员倒计时现在可用。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the radiation events and their text.
english: Added unit tests for the radiation events and their text.
chinese: 为辐射事件及其文本添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed vessels in older saves being left out when loading if one of their parts has changed since. The vessel now loads with its parts where they were saved and a warning asks you to check how they're attached.
english: Fixed vessels in older saves being left out when loading if one of their parts has changed since. The vessel now loads with its parts where they were saved and a warning asks you to check how they're attached.
chinese: 修复了旧保存文件中的载具在加载时被遗漏的问题，如果其某个部件自那时起已更改。载具现在会以其保存时的部件加载，并会发出警告提示您检查它们的连接方式。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed tanks in the Mk1 Cargo Bay (Double) breaking saves made before its connectors changed.
english: Fixed tanks in the Mk1 Cargo Bay (Double) breaking saves made before its connectors changed.
chinese: 修复了 Mk1 货舱（双）中的罐子在连接器更改之前创建的保存文件损坏的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Update Vulkan abstractions to v2026.11.1.
english: Update Vulkan abstractions to v2026.11.1.
chinese: 更新 Vulkan 抽象到 v2026.11.1。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Enable shader debug info in all non-production build types.
english: Enable shader debug info in all non-production build types.
chinese: 在所有非生产构建类型中启用着色器调试信息。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Life Support window in the editor now lets you set each habitat's meals and canisters and pick the kitten for each seat, the same as the part window.
english: The Life Support window in the editor now lets you set each habitat's meals and canisters and pick the kitten for each seat, the same as the part window.
chinese: 编辑器中的生命保障窗口现在允许您为每个栖息地设置餐食和罐装物，并为每个座位选择喵航员，这与部件窗口相同。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Hovering a zone in the Life Support window while planning a mission now highlights it yellow when its supplies fall short of the mission, green when they are enough, and plain purple when the mission doesn't use it.
english: Hovering a zone in the Life Support window while planning a mission now highlights it yellow when its supplies fall short of the mission, green when they are enough, and plain purple when the mission doesn't use it.
chinese: 在生命保障窗口中悬停于计划任务时的区域，当补给不足时高亮显示为黄色，充足时为绿色，任务未使用时为普通紫色。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The Crew Clock now also shows when a kitten's supply runs low, goes critical and runs out, the three moments that already stop time warp, before it counts down to the kitten being degraded.
english: The Crew Clock now also shows when a kitten's supply runs low, goes critical and runs out, the three moments that already stop time warp, before it counts down to the kitten being degraded.
chinese: 乘员倒计时现在还会显示喵航员的补给何时耗尽、危急和用完，这三个时刻之前时间扭曲会停止（此前这些时刻已停止时间扭曲），然后倒计时至喵航员退化。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed time warp only stopping for a vessel's worst habitat zone. Every crewed zone now warns and stops time warp when its supplies run low, go critical or run out.
english: Fixed time warp only stopping for a vessel's worst habitat zone. Every crewed zone now warns and stops time warp when its supplies run low, go critical or run out.
chinese: 修复了时间扭曲仅针对载具最差栖息区的问题。每个有人居住的区域现在会在其补给不足、危急或用完时发出警告并停止时间扭曲。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: A kitten that has gone without a supply for a while is now called "Impaired" instead of "Degraded" everywhere in the UI.
english: A kitten that has gone without a supply for a while is now called "Impaired" instead of "Degraded" everywhere in the UI.
chinese: UI 中不再将长时间未获得补给的喵航员称为“退化”，而是统一称为“受损”。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Once a supply has less than a day left the Crew Clock now counts down to the kitten becoming impaired instead of showing "critical" and "runs out". Time warp still stops at 1 hour left and when the supply runs out.
english: Once a supply has less than a day left the Crew Clock now counts down to the kitten becoming impaired instead of showing "critical" and "runs out". Time warp still stops at 1 hour left and when the supply runs out.
chinese: 一旦补给予一天以下，乘员倒计时现在倒计时至喵航员变为“受损”，而不是显示“危急”和“用完”。当补给予一小时时以及补给耗尽时，时间扭曲仍会停止。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Improved the performance of the voronoi noise by ~40%.
english: Improved the performance of the voronoi noise by ~40%.
chinese: Voronoi 噪声性能提升约 40%。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Ported terrain precision funcs that the GPU modifiers use to the CPU implementation.
english: Ported terrain precision funcs that the GPU modifiers use to the CPU implementation.
chinese: 将 GPU 修饰符使用的地形精度函数移植到 CPU 实现中。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed some centimeter differences in physical vs visual terrain. For most modifiers the difference is now sub-millimeter.
english: Fixed some centimeter differences in physical vs visual terrain. For most modifiers the difference is now sub-millimeter.
chinese: 修复了物理与视觉地形之间的厘米级差异。对于大多数修饰符，差异现在小于毫米。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reduced ground clutter VRAM usage by around 33% by not allocating for viewports that will never produce clutter (8 viewports -> 5). Earth trees VRAM usage from 200 to 134mb.
english: Reduced ground clutter VRAM usage by around 33% by not allocating for viewports that will never produce clutter (8 viewports -> 5). Earth trees VRAM usage from 200 to 134mb.
chinese: 通过不为永远不会产生杂乱的视口分配内存，将地面杂乱 VRAM 使用量减少了约 33%（8 个视口 -> 5 个）。地球树木 VRAM 使用量从 200MB 降至 134MB。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Add ambient light from clouds to opaque objects, render a coarse lighting volume similar to the existing cloud shadow and cloud ambient occlusion volumes and encode cloud radiance into spherical harmonics. An overcast sky now tints objects under it instead of keeping a blue ambient tint
english: Add ambient light from clouds to opaque objects, render a coarse lighting volume similar to the existing cloud shadow and cloud ambient occlusion volumes and encode cloud radiance into spherical harmonics. An overcast sky now tints objects under it instead of keeping a blue ambient tint
chinese: 为不透明物体添加来自云的环境光，渲染类似现有云阴影和云环境遮蔽的粗略光照体积，并将云辐射度编码到球谐函数中。现在多云的天空会对其下方的物体着色，而不是保持蓝色环境着色。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fix an issue with the ambient occlusion that made it apply at a very small scale near the camera, vessels and surfaces now look better as the ambient occlusion better interacts with the new ambient lighting
english: Fix an issue with the ambient occlusion that made it apply at a very small scale near the camera, vessels and surfaces now look better as the ambient occlusion better interacts with the new ambient lighting
chinese: 修复了环境遮蔽在相机附近以非常小的尺度应用的问题，载具和表面看起来更好，因为环境遮蔽与新环境光照更好地相互作用。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Apply ambient occlusion to the planet shine vessels receive
english: Apply ambient occlusion to the planet shine vessels receive
chinese: 将环境遮蔽应用于行星发光载具接收的部分。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fix opaque objects sampling cloud shadow volume one frame early when the volume rebases
english: Fix opaque objects sampling cloud shadow volume one frame early when the volume rebases
chinese: 修复不透明物体采样云阴影体积过早（重基前一帧）的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fix issue where the cloud shadows can appear on terrain sitting slightly above the actual clouds, add a height fraction lookup to the shadow lut
english: Fix issue where the cloud shadows can appear on terrain sitting slightly above the actual clouds, add a height fraction lookup to the shadow lut
chinese: 修复了云阴影可能出现在略高于实际云的地形上的问题，在阴影查找表中添加了高度分数查找。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Small performance improvement in the cloud ambient occlusion volume, deduplicating identical upwards ray in the hemisphere sampling
english: Small performance improvement in the cloud ambient occlusion volume, deduplicating identical upwards ray in the hemisphere sampling
chinese: 云环境遮蔽体积的小性能改进，在半球采样中重复相同的向上射线。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed an error where a vehicle could go into the landed state while near orbital velocity because it was only considering frame-relative velocity, but the frame itself was moving at multiple km/s relative to the planet surface.
english: Fixed an error where a vehicle could go into the landed state while near orbital velocity because it was only considering frame-relative velocity, but the frame itself was moving at multiple km/s relative to the planet surface.
chinese: 修复了一个错误：由于仅考虑相对于帧的速度，载具可能在接近轨道速度时进入着陆状态，但帧本身相对于行星表面以多个 km/s 的速度移动。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Put all physics bubbles into CCF if any of the member vehicles want to be in CCF so that we can't miss terrain collisions.
english: Put all physics bubbles into CCF if any of the member vehicles want to be in CCF so that we can't miss terrain collisions.
chinese: 将所有物理气泡放入 CCF，只要任何成员载具希望位于 CCF 中即可，以免错过地形碰撞。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The chute physics timestep calculation now uses airspeed rather than inertial speed.
english: The chute physics timestep calculation now uses airspeed rather than inertial speed.
chinese: 降落伞物理时间步长计算现在使用空速而非惯性速度。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Particle drag is now relative to airspeed rather than inertial speed.
english: Particle drag is now relative to airspeed rather than inertial speed.
chinese: 粒子阻力现在相对于空速而非惯性速度。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Tank frost thawing is now driven by dynamic pressure and frost buildup is scaled by atmospheric density.
english: Tank frost thawing is now driven by dynamic pressure and frost buildup is scaled by atmospheric density.
chinese: 罐体霜冻融化现在由动态压力驱动，霜冻积累按大气密度缩放。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed a potential deadlock with the vehicle workers where a job-posting thread awaiting a batch could pick up a job from another batch entirely, which could then await again and never make progress. We now restrict awaiting threads to only ever take jobs from the batch they are awaiting on.
english: Fixed a potential deadlock with the vehicle workers where a job-posting thread awaiting a batch could pick up a job from another batch entirely, which could then await again and never make progress. We now restrict awaiting threads to only ever take jobs from the batch they are awaiting on.
chinese: 修复了车辆工作者中潜在的死锁问题：一个作业发布线程等待批次时可能从另一个完全不同的批次中获取作业，然后再次等待并永远无法进展。我们现在限制等待线程只能从其正在等待的批次中获取作业。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Render the cloud shadows off-screen, this separates the cloud shadow rendering from multiple opaque shaders like the terrain and allows rendering them at lower resolution, giving a performance improvement
english: Render the cloud shadows off-screen, this separates the cloud shadow rendering from multiple opaque shaders like the terrain and allows rendering them at lower resolution, giving a performance improvement
chinese: 将云阴影渲染在屏幕外，这使云阴影渲染与地形等多层不透明着色器分离，允许以较低分辨率渲染它们，从而提升性能。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Use the more accurate but lower resolution 3d cloud shadow volume near the camera and fade to the 2d cloud shadows in the distance, this allows the cloud shadows to better match nearby clouds
english: Use the more accurate but lower resolution 3d cloud shadow volume near the camera and fade to the 2d cloud shadows in the distance, this allows the cloud shadows to better match nearby clouds
chinese: 使用更精确但分辨率较低的 3D 云阴影体积靠近相机，并渐隐至远处的 2D 云阴影，这使得云阴影能更好地匹配附近的云层。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Better match the 2d cloud shadows to the cloud heights
english: Better match the 2d cloud shadows to the cloud heights
chinese: 更好地匹配 2D 云阴影与云高。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Soften the 2d cloud shadows appearance
english: Soften the 2d cloud shadows appearance
chinese: 柔化 2D 云阴影外观。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Filter the cloud shadow luts to avoid aliasing and shimmering, especially now that the cloud shadows are rendered at low resolution
english: Filter the cloud shadow luts to avoid aliasing and shimmering, especially now that the cloud shadows are rendered at low resolution
chinese: 过滤云阴影查找表以避免混叠和闪烁，尤其是现在云阴影以低分辨率渲染时。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fade the cascaded shadowmaps out smoothly instead of cutting off abruptly
english: Fade the cascaded shadowmaps out smoothly instead of cutting off abruptly
chinese: 平滑地渐隐级联阴影贴图，而不是突然切断。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Continue to optimize color target texture formats to improve GPU performance and reduce VRAM usage.
english: Continue to optimize color target texture formats to improve GPU performance and reduce VRAM usage.
chinese: 继续优化颜色目标纹理格式以提升 GPU 性能并减少 VRAM 使用量。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Enable debug range markers in all non-production build types.
english: Enable debug range markers in all non-production build types.
chinese: 在所有非生产构建类型中启用调试范围标记。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Replaced the old cylindrical aerodynamic model with supersonic-only aerodynamics. We feed the newly-generated aero meshes through a supersonic panel method to resolve drag, lift, and rotational moments. Panels behind the wake of other panels are resolved correctly.
english: Replaced the old cylindrical aerodynamic model with supersonic-only aerodynamics. We feed the newly-generated aero meshes through a supersonic panel method to resolve drag, lift, and rotational moments. Panels behind the wake of other panels are resolved correctly.
chinese: 用仅超音速空气动力学模型替换了旧的圆柱形空气动力学模型。我们将新生成的气动网格通过超音速面板方法解析阻力、升力和旋转力矩。尾流后面面板的解析是正确的。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: At the moment we use the supersonic model even when vehicles are subsonic - this will be replaced with a subsonic panel method in the future.
english: At the moment we use the supersonic model even when vehicles are subsonic - this will be replaced with a subsonic panel method in the future.
chinese: 目前我们即使在车辆亚音速时也使用超音速模型——未来将被亚音速面板方法取代。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a new thermo toolkit generator for an ideal gas local inclination lookup table.
english: Added a new thermo toolkit generator for an ideal gas local inclination lookup table.
chinese: 添加了用于理想气体局部倾角查找表的新热力学工具包生成器。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added dynamic viscosity data to atmospheres, which drives a laminar -> turbulent boundary layer model of skin friction.
english: Added dynamic viscosity data to atmospheres, which drives a laminar -> turbulent boundary layer model of skin friction.
chinese: 向大气中添加了动态粘度数据，驱动了从层流到湍流的边界层摩擦模型。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a visualization of aerodynamic pressure to the aerodynamics debug view.
english: Added a visualization of aerodynamic pressure to the aerodynamics debug view.
chinese: 将气动压力可视化添加到了空气动力学调试视图中。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed cases where quads could be triangulated in ways that made their two normals deviate significantly from the ideal quad normal.
english: Fixed cases where quads could be triangulated in ways that made their two normals deviate significantly from the ideal quad normal.
chinese: 修复了四边形可能被以使其两个法线显著偏离理想四边形法线的方向进行三角化的情况。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed key prompts in popups showing the old key after rebinding it, and stopped the EVA Grab, Board and Supplies prompts creating garbage every frame.
english: Fixed key prompts in popups showing the old key after rebinding it, and stopped the EVA Grab, Board and Supplies prompts creating garbage every frame.
chinese: 修复了弹出窗口中显示旧按键的提示，并停止了 EVA 抓取、登舱和补给提示每帧生成垃圾的问题。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a placeholder interior to the HM-2 and HM-3 Habitat Modules. From an IVA seat or a crew portrait you now see the inside of the hull instead of looking out through it.
english: Added a placeholder interior to the HM-2 and HM-3 Habitat Modules. From an IVA seat or a crew portrait you now see the inside of the hull instead of looking out through it.
chinese: 为 HM-2 和 HM-3 居住模块添加了占位内部结构。现在从 IVA 座椅或船员肖像处可以看到船体内部，而不是透过船体向外看。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Mesh atlases can now load meshes inside out. Setting Inverted="true" on a MeshAtlas with a <Meshes> list loads just those meshes with their faces reversed, as <name>_Inverted.
english: Mesh atlases can now load meshes inside out. Setting Inverted="true" on a MeshAtlas with a <Meshes> list loads just those meshes with their faces reversed, as <name>_Inverted.
chinese: 网格图集现在可以加载反向的网格。在具有 <Meshes> 列表的 MeshAtlas 上设置 Inverted="true" 将仅加载那些面反转的网格，命名为_<name>_Inverted。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the above.
english: Added unit tests for the above.
chinese: 为上述内容添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reduced the number of particle emitters allocated for pooling, from 1024 down to 128. The current number of particles used in the game was not utilizing the number of emitters allocated, meaning that VRAM was getting wasted preallocating particle buffers that were never used.
english: Reduced the number of particle emitters allocated for pooling, from 1024 down to 128. The current number of particles used in the game was not utilizing the number of emitters allocated, meaning that VRAM was getting wasted preallocating particle buffers that were never used.
chinese: 减少了用于池化的粒子发射器数量，从 1024 减少到 128。游戏中当前使用的粒子数量并未利用分配的发射器数量，这意味着 VRAM 在预分配从未使用的粒子缓冲区时被浪费。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Move asynchronously/rarely read ground clutter generation buffers from device memory to host memory. Saves ~1.2GB of VRAM on GPUs supporting ray tracing (even when the IVH ray tracing setting is off).
english: Move asynchronously/rarely read ground clutter generation buffers from device memory to host memory. Saves ~1.2GB of VRAM on GPUs supporting ray tracing (even when the IVH ray tracing setting is off).
chinese: 将地面杂物生成缓冲区的异步/偶尔读取从设备内存移动到主机内存。在支持光线追踪的 GPU 上可节省约 1.2GB VRAM（即使 IVH 光线追踪设置关闭）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added ability to pick where supplies go by clicking a habitat on the vessel while transferring. Habitats you can move supplies to light up green, hovering one shows the arrow, and Esc or right-click stops picking.
english: Added ability to pick where supplies go by clicking a habitat on the vessel while transferring. Habitats you can move supplies to light up green, hovering one shows the arrow, and Esc or right-click stops picking.
chinese: 添加了通过点击船上的居住区来选择补给去向的功能。可以移动补给的居住区会亮起绿色，悬停显示箭头，Esc 或右键点击停止选择。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Changed the life support Transfer popup to a Transfer Supplies window so clicking a habitat on the vessel no longer closes it.
english: Changed the life support Transfer popup to a Transfer Supplies window so clicking a habitat on the vessel no longer closes it.
chinese: 将生命保障 Transfer 弹出窗口改为 Transfer Supplies 窗口，这样点击船上的居住区不再关闭它。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a reusable part picker for any feature that lets you click parts on a vessel. It handles the highlighting, hover tooltips, clicking to pick and cancelling.
english: Added a reusable part picker for any feature that lets you click parts on a vessel. It handles the highlighting, hover tooltips, clicking to pick and cancelling.
chinese: 为任何允许点击船体部件的功能添加了可复用的部件选择器。它处理高亮、悬停提示框、点击选择和取消操作。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added unit tests for the part picker.
english: Added unit tests for the part picker.
chinese: 为部件选择器添加了单元测试。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: kFS editor, UI and performance work (kFS code only, not yet hooked into the game)
english: kFS editor, UI and performance work (kFS code only, not yet hooked into the game)
chinese: kFS 编辑器、UI 和性能工作（仅 kFS 代码，尚未挂钩到游戏中）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added the kFS editor window, reference windows and file/project dialog.
english: Added the kFS editor window, reference windows and file/project dialog.
chinese: 添加了 kFS 编辑器窗口、参考窗口和文件/项目对话框。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The editor's Code tab highlights the lines the VM is running in fading green scanlines (o-scope persistence, 1 s to 60 s or infinite), on by default and has a toggle and fade slider.
english: The editor's Code tab highlights the lines the VM is running in fading green scanlines (o-scope persistence, 1 s to 60 s or infinite), on by default and has a toggle and fade slider.
chinese: 编辑器的 Code 标签页高亮显示 VM 正在运行的行，以淡绿色扫描线显示（o-scope 持久化，1 秒至 60 秒或无限），默认开启，并带有切换和淡入淡出滑块。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The kFS VM runs no tick while a requested stage() is pending, so a tick can't run between the request and the host processing the stage.
english: The kFS VM runs no tick while a requested stage() is pending, so a tick can't run between the request and the host processing the stage.
chinese: 当请求的 stage() 处于待处理状态时，kFS VM 不运行 tick，因此 request 和主机处理 stage 之间无法运行 tick。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Host leaf handles are now resolved by a dictionary lookup on a cached layout when the image loads, instead of rebuilding the vehicle message layout for each handle on the first tick.
english: Host leaf handles are now resolved by a dictionary lookup on a cached layout when the image loads, instead of rebuilding the vehicle message layout for each handle on the first tick.
chinese: 图像加载时，现在通过字典查找缓存布局来解析主机叶句柄，而不是在每个 tick 上为每个句柄重新构建车辆消息布局。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Message layouts can be built without per-element leaves. Generated vehicle headers are made once per layout instead of on every compile.
english: Message layouts can be built without per-element leaves. Generated vehicle headers are made once per layout instead of on every compile.
chinese: 消息布局可以在没有每元素叶的情况下构建。生成的车辆头文件每次布局仅生成一次，而不是每次编译都生成。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Editor allocations pass: text is formatted into reused buffers, views are rebuilt only when their input changes, scope trace buffers are pooled and the file tree is relisted only on file system changes. Added per-tab allocation meters to the Perf tab.
english: Editor allocations pass: text is formatted into reused buffers, views are rebuilt only when their input changes, scope trace buffers are pooled and the file tree is relisted only on file system changes. Added per-tab allocation meters to the Perf tab.
chinese: 编辑器分配测试通过：文本格式化到重用缓冲区，视图仅在输入变化时重建，作用域跟踪缓冲区池化，文件树仅在文件系统更改时重新列出。为 Perf 标签页添加了每个标签的分配计表。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Upload loads the editor's current build when it still matches the saved text and otherwise builds once in the background.
english: Upload loads the editor's current build when it still matches the saved text and otherwise builds once in the background.
chinese: 上传功能：当编辑器当前构建版本与保存文本匹配时加载，否则在后台执行一次构建。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: The VM asks once for the program's settings to be cleared when kFS gives up control (used by the pilot handback in the next commit).
english: The VM asks once for the program's settings to be cleared when kFS gives up control (used by the pilot handback in the next commit).
chinese: 虚拟机（VM）会在 kFS 放弃控制权时询问一次是否清除程序设置（由下一次提交中的飞行员接管功能使用）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Core library UI pass. Unsaved file edits are now kept in memory. Examples are reworked and organized. Added summary fields to the opcode and service tables for the in-game reference.
english: Core library UI pass. Unsaved file edits are now kept in memory. Examples are reworked and organized. Added summary fields to the opcode and service tables for the in-game reference.
chinese: 核心库 UI 迭代完成。未保存的文件编辑现在保留在内存中。示例已重新设计和整理。为游戏内参考添加了操作码和服务表的摘要字段。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tests for the above, including ExecTraceTests, LiveLinesTests, MessageLayoutTests, HostLeafMapTests, StageHoldTests and UploadTests.
english: Added tests for the above, including ExecTraceTests, LiveLinesTests, MessageLayoutTests, HostLeafMapTests, StageHoldTests and UploadTests.
chinese: 添加了上述功能的测试，包括 ExecTraceTests、LiveLinesTests、MessageLayoutTests、HostLeafMapTests、StageHoldTests 和 UploadTests。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: kFS in-game hooks: integration layer and hooks into the physics bubble, vehicle and program
english: kFS in-game hooks: integration layer and hooks into the physics bubble, vehicle and program
chinese: kFS 游戏内钩子：集成层以及对物理气泡、载具和程序的钩子。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added the kFS game integration layer: vehicle hosts, services, host messages and the `kfs` console command (KfsVehicleHost, KfsServices, KfsHostSampler, KfsControllerSet, KfsEngineModel, KfsWriteBack, KfsIntegration, KfsConsoleCommands).
english: Added the kFS game integration layer: vehicle hosts, services, host messages and the `kfs` console command (KfsVehicleHost, KfsServices, KfsHostSampler, KfsControllerSet, KfsEngineModel, KfsWriteBack, KfsIntegration, KfsConsoleCommands).
chinese: 添加了 kFS 游戏集成层：车辆托管、服务、主机消息以及 `kfs` 控制台命令（KfsVehicleHost, KfsServices, KfsHostSampler, KfsControllerSet, KfsEngineModel, KfsWriteBack, KfsIntegration, KfsConsoleCommands）。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: PhysicsBubble: The flight computer's three call sites go through RunFlightComputer, which lets a vehicle's kFS computer answer first (KfsDispatch) and otherwise runs the stock FlightComputer. A kFS computer's next tick is tracked apart from the stock wake requests and is held to neither the stock tick grid nor the MaxFlightComputerRate floor. FlightComputerInputsFor is now internal for pilot mode.
english: PhysicsBubble: The flight computer's three call sites go through RunFlightComputer, which lets a vehicle's kFS computer answer first (KfsDispatch) and otherwise runs the stock FlightComputer. A kFS computer's next tick is tracked apart from the stock wake requests and is held to neither the stock tick grid nor the MaxFlightComputerRate floor. FlightComputerInputsFor is now internal for pilot mode.
chinese: 物理气泡：飞行计算机的三个调用点通过 RunFlightComputer 运行，这允许载具的 kFS 计算机优先响应（KfsDispatch），否则运行标准 FlightComputer。kFS 计算机的下一个时间步与标准唤醒请求分开跟踪，既不遵循标准时间网格也不受 MaxFlightComputerRate 上限限制。FlightComputerInputsFor 现在对飞行员模式为内部组件。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: PhysicsStepDiagnostics: Added the KfsTick step limit ("kFS Tick").
english: PhysicsStepDiagnostics: Added the KfsTick step limit ("kFS Tick").
chinese: 物理步骤诊断：添加了 KfsTick 步骤限制（
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Vehicle: Added the KfsHost slot.
english: Vehicle: Added the KfsHost slot.
chinese: kFS Tick
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Program: Registers the kfs command, the editor window and the frame hook (non-production builds). Applies the computers' main-thread requests before input events.
english: Program: Registers the kfs command, the editor window and the frame hook (non-production builds). Applies the computers' main-thread requests before input events.
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: KfsDispatch: The hook PhysicsBubble calls. A host exception is contained and falls back to the stock flight computer.
english: KfsDispatch: The hook PhysicsBubble calls. A host exception is contained and falls back to the stock flight computer.
chinese: 载具：添加了 KfsHost 槽位。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: kFS hands vehicle control back to the pilot in a safe state on every exit path (kfs stop, kill, off, a host fault, a new load, or the program ending). Burn mode goes back to Manual, attitude to a zero-rate inertial hold with roll decoupled, and the attitude profile back to Balanced. The engine switch is turned off and unfinished program burns are cancelled. Planned burns and the pilot's own settings changes are kept.
english: kFS hands vehicle control back to the pilot in a safe state on every exit path (kfs stop, kill, off, a host fault, a new load, or the program ending). Burn mode goes back to Manual, attitude to a zero-rate inertial hold with roll decoupled, and the attitude profile back to Balanced. The engine switch is turned off and unfinished program burns are cancelled. Planned burns and the pilot's own settings changes are kept.
chinese: 程序：注册了 kfs 命令、编辑器窗口和时间步钩子（非生产构建版本）。在输入事件之前应用计算机的主线程请求。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed a physics worker stall on VM start: the host sampler and leaf map are built when an image loads, not on the first tick.
english: Fixed a physics worker stall on VM start: the host sampler and leaf map are built when an image loads, not on the first tick.
chinese: KfsDispatch：物理气泡调用的钩子。主机异常被捕获并回退到标准飞行计算机。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tests: BurnEndTests, CopiedGameLogicTests, HandbackTests, ConsoleCommandTests, Ms11bConsoleTests and Ms11cConsoleTests.
english: Added tests: BurnEndTests, CopiedGameLogicTests, HandbackTests, ConsoleCommandTests, Ms11bConsoleTests and Ms11cConsoleTests.
chinese: kFS 在每个退出路径（kfs stop, kill, off, 主机故障、新加载或程序结束）上安全地将载具控制权交还给飞行员。燃烧模式返回手动模式，姿态设置为零速率惯性保持且翻滚解耦，姿态配置返回平衡模式。发动机切换已关闭，未完成的程序燃烧已取消。计划燃烧和飞行员的设置更改被保留。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Moved some state and command settings from RocketCore to Rocket in anticipation of some additional complexity for certain engines.
english: Moved some state and command settings from RocketCore to Rocket in anticipation of some additional complexity for certain engines.
chinese: 修复了虚拟机启动时的物理工作线程停滞问题：主机采样器和叶映射在图像加载时构建，而不是在第一个时间步构建。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Split solid rockets into a dedicated SolidRocket class to avoid having solid-specific code in Rocket itself.
english: Split solid rockets into a dedicated SolidRocket class to avoid having solid-specific code in Rocket itself.
chinese: 添加了测试：BurnEndTests, CopiedGameLogicTests, HandbackTests, ConsoleCommandTests, Ms11bConsoleTests 和 Ms11cConsoleTests。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed badly wrong MMH density derived from a bad database constant. Added a sanity check to catch future implausible values.
english: Fixed badly wrong MMH density derived from a bad database constant. Added a sanity check to catch future implausible values.
chinese: 出于某些发动机可能增加的复杂性考虑，将 RocketCore 中的一些状态和命令设置移至 Rocket。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reduced the frame stall when placing symmetry, radial or mounted copies of large part groups in the vehicle editor.
english: Reduced the frame stall when placing symmetry, radial or mounted copies of large part groups in the vehicle editor.
chinese: 将固体火箭拆分为独立的 SolidRocket 类，以避免在 Rocket 本身中包含特定于固体的代码。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Copied parts now add their modules to the vehicle while each copy is built, which makes this step about 4x faster on large symmetry drops.
english: Copied parts now add their modules to the vehicle while each copy is built, which makes this step about 4x faster on large symmetry drops.
chinese: 已复制的部件现在在构建时将其模块添加到载具中，这使得在大对称性掉落时的此步骤速度约为原来的 4 倍。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Detaching a large part group in the vehicle editor no longer builds module lookup tables that it does not need, and allocates less memory.
english: Detaching a large part group in the vehicle editor no longer builds module lookup tables that it does not need, and allocates less memory.
chinese: 在载具编辑器中分离大型部件组不再构建其不需要的模块查找表，并分配更少的内存。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added tests that check the modules of a vehicle after parts are split off, merged back or copied.
english: Added tests that check the modules of a vehicle after parts are split off, merged back or copied.
chinese: 添加了测试以检查部件拆分、合并或复制后载具的模块。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed crash when starting the game with ground clutter disabled.
english: Fixed crash when starting the game with ground clutter disabled.
chinese: 修复了在禁用地面杂物时启动游戏导致的崩溃。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added other star systems to the life support Mission destinations. Pick a star or one of its planets and set a Cruise speed as a fraction of light speed. The trip is timed as a straight line between the stars.
english: Added other star systems to the life support Mission destinations. Pick a star or one of its planets and set a Cruise speed as a fraction of light speed. The trip is timed as a straight line between the stars.
chinese: 向生命保障任务目的地添加了其他恒星系统。选择一颗恒星或其行星，并将巡航速度设置为光速的分数。行程时间按恒星之间的直线计算。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Add internal debug option to disable pipeline cache.
english: Add internal debug option to disable pipeline cache.
chinese: 添加了内部调试选项以禁用管道缓存。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added hand authored ToSurface connector for radial fuel tank parts so the models frame clips nicely into the mounted on part rather than floating over the surface.
english: Added hand authored ToSurface connector for radial fuel tank parts so the models frame clips nicely into the mounted on part rather than floating over the surface.
chinese: 为径向燃料罐部件添加了手动编写的 ToSurface 连接器，以便模型框架能很好地嵌入安装部件而不是悬浮在表面之上。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added kFS debug window with a tick flame graph, sanity limits for player programs, and 1 MHz clocks on every part
english: Added kFS debug window with a tick flame graph, sanity limits for player programs, and 1 MHz clocks on every part
chinese: 添加了 kFS 调试窗口，包含计算机 tick 火焰图、玩家程序的健康限制以及每个部件的 1 MHz 时钟。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added a kFS debug window (Show kFS Debug) with a flame graph of a computer's tick.
english: Added a kFS debug window (Show kFS Debug) with a flame graph of a computer's tick.
chinese: 添加了 kFS 调试窗口（显示 kFS 调试），其中包含计算机 tick 的火焰图。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Tick dispatch records profiler zones per vehicle, only while a view is asking and only for dispatches that run a tick.
english: Tick dispatch records profiler zones per vehicle, only while a view is asking and only for dispatches that run a tick.
chinese: Tick 分发记录每辆车的 profiler 区域，仅在请求查看时且仅针对运行 tick 的分发进行记录。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: CpuProfiler: Added a constructor that shares an existing root tag.
english: CpuProfiler: Added a constructor that shares an existing root tag.
chinese: CpuProfiler：添加了一个共享现有根标签的构造函数。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Added per-computer limits: 256 service requests per tick, 20 console events per second, 64 trace channels, 8 live plans, a 4 ms frame budget and a 4 MiB source cap.
english: Added per-computer limits: 256 service requests per tick, 20 console events per second, 64 trace channels, 8 live plans, a 4 ms frame budget and a 4 MiB source cap.
chinese: 添加了每台计算机的限制：每秒 tick 256 个服务请求、每秒 20 个控制台事件、64 个跟踪通道、8 个实时计划、4 ms 帧预算和 4 MiB 源上限。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Player commands are clamped to their valid ranges, and an exception in a computer's dispatch stops that computer instead of the game.
english: Player commands are clamped to their valid ranges, and an exception in a computer's dispatch stops that computer instead of the game.
chinese: 玩家命令被限制在其有效范围内，并且计算机分发中的异常会停止该计算机而不是游戏。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Every part now runs a 1 MHz clock: 20,000 cycles per tick at 50 Hz, 100,000 at 10 Hz.
english: Every part now runs a 1 MHz clock: 20,000 cycles per tick at 50 Hz, 100,000 at 10 Hz.
chinese: 每个部件现在运行 1 MHz 时钟：50 Hz 时为每秒 tick 20,000 个周期，10 Hz 时为 100,000 个周期。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reference programs and tests that no longer fit a 50 Hz tick now run at 5 Hz.
english: Reference programs and tests that no longer fit a 50 Hz tick now run at 5 Hz.
chinese: 不再适配 50 Hz tick 的参考程序和测试现在以 5 Hz 运行。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed gauge panel text not scaling with the game resolution. Text inside the Crew, Resources, Sequence and Burn panels now keeps the same share of its panel at any window size instead of staying a fixed pixel size while the panel shrank or grew.
english: Fixed gauge panel text not scaling with the game resolution. Text inside the Crew, Resources, Sequence and Burn panels now keeps the same share of its panel at any window size instead of staying a fixed pixel size while the panel shrank or grew.
chinese: 修复了仪表板文本未随游戏分辨率缩放的问题。Crew、Resources、Sequence 和 Burn 面板内的文本现在在任何窗口大小下都保持其面板的相同比例，而不是在面板缩小或增大时保持固定的像素大小。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed the crew portrait panel's portraits shrinking and leaving empty space at lower resolutions. The panel's auto-size no longer makes its own text bigger each time it resizes and the panel keeps the same shape at every resolution. Its text now follows the panel's width so dragging it wider still enlarges the text.
english: Fixed the crew portrait panel's portraits shrinking and leaving empty space at lower resolutions. The panel's auto-size no longer makes its own text bigger each time it resizes and the panel keeps the same shape at every resolution. Its text now follows the panel's width so dragging it wider still enlarges the text.
chinese: 修复了船员肖像面板中的肖像在较低分辨率下缩小并留下空白空间的问题。面板的自动大小不再每次调整大小时使其文本变大，并且面板在所有分辨率下保持相同的形状。其文本现在跟随面板宽度，因此将其拖得更宽仍然会放大文本。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed Resources bar labels running past the end of their bars. All labels now share one font size, the one that fits the longest label and the bars shorten to match.
english: Fixed Resources bar labels running past the end of their bars. All labels now share one font size, the one that fits the longest label and the bars shorten to match.
chinese: 修复了 Resources 栏标签超出其栏末端的问题。所有标签现在共享一种字体大小，即适合最长标签的大小，并且栏缩短以匹配。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed the Resources panel's last bar poking out past its rounded bottom edge. The panel now sizes itself from the same row heights it draws with a little more room under the last bar.
english: Fixed the Resources panel's last bar poking out past its rounded bottom edge. The panel now sizes itself from the same row heights it draws with a little more room under the last bar.
chinese: 修复了资源面板最后一栏超出其圆角底部边缘的问题。该面板现在会根据绘制行的高度进行缩放，并在最后一栏下方留出更多空间。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Fixed "Isp" and "TWR" overlapping on the staging panel's stat line. Isp stays centred when there's room and moves left to clear TWR when there isn't.
english: Fixed "Isp" and "TWR" overlapping on the staging panel's stat line. Isp stays centred when there's room and moves left to clear TWR when there isn't.
chinese: 修复了"比冲"和"推力重量比"在变轨面板状态栏上的重叠问题。当有足够空间时，比冲保持居中；否则向左移动以避开推力重量比。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Reduced memory use when building sub-parts in the vehicle editor: a sub-part's own module list now uses a compact form until it needs more.
english: Reduced memory use when building sub-parts in the vehicle editor: a sub-part's own module list now uses a compact form until it needs more.
chinese: 优化了载具编辑器中构建子部件时的内存使用：子部件自身的模块列表现在采用紧凑格式，直到需要更多空间为止。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: kFS can now be enabled through the debug menu
english: kFS can now be enabled through the debug menu
chinese: kFS 现在可以通过调试菜单启用。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.

key: Formatting pass on kFS code examples
english: Formatting pass on kFS code examples
chinese: 对 kFS 代码示例进行了格式化处理。
notes: Changelog body only; revision, date and author are separate game fields.
